Thanks to the collaboration between the Laplace Universal Materials Enchantment Department and the Arcane Skills Storage Department, it is now easier to attach Arcane Skills stored on floppy disks to items. They can be used by humans and are now widely available.
No one knows what kind of animal this tooth came from. All that is certain is that every time it is touched, an inexplicable power surges from within.
A thick black staff—though it is more like a wooden stick than a staff in size. Whenever you fail to cast an incantation, you can just throw it instead and do the same amount of damage.
The paw of a bear cub. It stopped growing before it had a chance to get thicker and sharper. The wounds it can inflict are as deep as a mother bear's grief.

A relatively old walking stick that can be used to support one's body, show off one's stateliness, or beat up slackers of the younger generation. It wasn't made with arcane skills, but it can make people stand up straight and maintain a proper posture.

A pair of multifunctional wool shears with thorny shrubs growing on them. Its branches and leaves can soothe sheep during the shearing process and inflict a more complex brand of pain on enemies you wish to attack.
An arrow made of fragile bone fragments. Its splintering damage effectively increases its lethality against groups of enemies at the cost of spending a few hours gluing it together before battle.
A twisted pair of forceps—a cavity sufferer's nightmare. Just pulling this thing out is enough to make people shake in their boots.
The most interesting thing about this shotgun is not what it does, but the fact that it shoots at all. How does it actually shoot bullets out of its crooked chamber?

The legacy of a legendary farmer from La Mancha. It is said that this farmer was once a governor, and that this pumpkin club was a gift given to him by the locals as a token of affection during his tenure.
The legacy of a legendary squire from La Mancha. It is said that this squire once won a glorious battle for Mambrino's helmet, and this pitchfork was one of the spoils of that battle.
Thanks to the whims of an aristocrat while camping in the wilderness, this torch made of cheap coarse cloth and a wooden stick was coated with expensive whale blubber, instantly doubling its value.

Zeno Arms Academy provides this weapon to its students for their daily shooting practice. The wooden grip of this crossbow has many inscriptions on it, such as "I Love Tracy," "Flight Training Sucks," and "Selling Wilderness Survival Guide."
A beautiful flintlock pistol. It can't guarantee you sustained firepower in actual combat, but it can make you look as cool as a pirate.

An arcane biologist came up with this invention in a hurry. After encountering a Preying Statue and exhausting his crossbow bolts, he placed the Critter teeth he had collected for research in his backpack into this crossbow to give it a little more bite.
It followed a king to conquer the land and witnessed the investiture of many knighthoods. Now it lies in a soft, luxurious silk fabric, with a decorative significance far beyond its practical value.
A strange chainsaw that works without making any noise. It raises the question—is it the chainsaw itself or the noise that scares people?

A pistol designed specifically for duels, with a streamlined design to reduce drag when drawing. It also comes with a white glove to prevent the embarrassment of wanting to start a duel but not having a gauntlet to throw down.
A slingshot of unknown origin. They say that fate is unpredictable, but at least at this moment—the moment you come in contact with its soft, white fur—you hold a piece of your destiny in your hands.
One of the technological achievements of Laplace. The chaos caused by the "Storm" was widespread and long lasting. This energy blaster also lost its owner in the disaster.
Despite its missing matching counterpart, this left boxing glove is incredibly useful. It's like having an aging but dependable father by your side, always ready to protect you.
Despite its missing matching counterpart, this right boxing glove is incredibly useful. It would be a shame to throw it away... It just needs to find a new partner.
An unregulated serum that can be purchased in alchemy shops. To maintain the potency of the solution and prove its harmlessness to health, some alchemists have a tradition of placing a fish inside.

A makeshift fowling piece that does not even deserve to be classified as a "custom weapon". However, it has the ability to kill two enemies with a single shot on the battlefield, making it deceptively effective.

A gun magazine that provides endless ammunition and an endless racket—a failed arcane skill transformation. In the creator's own words, "I guess I just wanted to talk to someone while I was casting the creation skill. I get lonely sometimes—really lonely ... Thoughts like that pop into my head all the time."

A terrifying weapon that doubles its lethality in the dry season due to high levels of static electricity. Remember to be careful when storing it—placing it in an insulated pet carrier is recommended.

A bouquet of mistletoe picked in the early morning. This is not the kind you're familiar with—it has never experienced a forest fire or the rebirth that follows. It is also willing to share the blessings of the wilderness with you.
A jar of basil nectar to be placed in a patient's wound. Primarily used for pain relief, it is most effective when the fingers are dipped into the jar and then directly into the mouth.
A piece of antler torn off a dying deer girl and planted in a flower pot to seal its remaining vitality. Those who hold compassion in their hearts rather than greed will receive its blessings.

The Dream Spider likes to spin her webs near the bed to capture your most delicate feelings while you sleep. Arcanists can use the vibrations in this spider's web to navigate dreams, a mutually beneficial relationship indeed.
Arcanists often find themselves caught in a maze of emotions and illusions. This cracked hand mirror offers them a path back to reality.
A perfectly made horseshoe, its craftsmanship admired by all. Just as a horse benefits from unimpeded movement, proper etiquette is essential to upholding virtue.
A beautifully crafted horse brush. Every well groomed horse knows that patience is a virtue.
This writhing, spirited stomach once belonged to an arcane sheep. To such an overwhelmingly powerful digestive system, thorns are no different than tender green leaves.

A perennial vine that prefers warmth and light, but cannot survive in dry conditions. When digging, the angle of the shovel should be carefully controlled to avoid damaging the tubers and reducing their protective effect.

Clearmoths are difficult to capture, and can only be detected by arcane optical skills. Upon reaching maturity, they enter a completely invisible phase, but for ease of identification, the surface of this adult specimen has been colored.

During the chrysalis stage, the Clearmoth's shell is hard and colorful. After emerging from the cocoon, the shell is shed and becomes soft and transparent. Thus, the Clearmoth cocoon possesses the dual qualities of transparency and transformation.

This phonograph, which devours all sound, has now been added to the Foundation's research list. A curious researcher once placed it next to the Roar Jukebox, and after an initial silence, an even louder noise and a greater spread of aphasia broke out among the organization's staff.
This ointment is not only a good analgesic, it can also serve as a deadly poison, its dark purple hue mimicking the dilated pupils of its confused and fainting ingester. Use with caution.
Someone once read fables about the roots and stamens of this plant spreading mightily over the land. Victory itself is power.
A glass spray bottle containing a mixture of Critter saliva. The owner no longer has to worry about losing a "war of words" due to poor speech.

Disclaimer: The ghosts and whimpering sounds produced are merely artificial creations attributed to the functionality of the product, simulated using arcane projection skills and sound recording techniques. No ghosts or spirits were harmed in the production of this lantern.

A vessel used to store incantations that can merge with and enhance the power of the incantations it holds. To make the color of its contents appear more enticing, many arcanists add useless incantations such as "Stains Remain" and "Clothes Be Wet".

One of Laplace's technological feats. Can convert lightning current into a controlled electrical barrier by turning a dial, effectively ensuring the safety of investigators in the field. The use of this device by untrained personnel is strictly prohibited.

A ubiquitous talisman that is said to bring all sorts of good luck, such as "not forgetting to bring an umbrella when leaving home," "finding your ID card before reporting it lost," and "free samples of Critter food."
Similar to growing a pearl in an oyster, planting a basket of iron nails and resentments deep in the fertile soil can produce this item during the next season's rains.
The story goes that this brooch was once pinned to the collar of a king who could no longer wield a sword. It stoically projects a moment of melancholy in its silver reflection.

A collector's item among the Danish nobility. It is said to have once wiped a prince's sweat during a duel and once absorbed poisoned wine from a queen's lips. The nobility believe it has been imbued with priceless wisdom.

Proof that ruffs can be both stylish and practical. This improved frilled lizard ruff not only reduces the strain on your cervical spine, but it can also be quite intimidating in battle. Trendsetters, you heard it here first—the wave of the future is here.

The ultimate accessory for professional potion alchemists! Featuring more storage space, more versatile container slots, and a more comfortable fit, a famous London auction house has already bought 200 of them!

Part of the "Law of the Jungle" accessory series. This series is designed to reflect the notions of wildness, sensuality, and power, with each accessory embodying a different concept. This particular piece symbolizes "Insight."
Shine like a star! Wearing this tie guarantees you the confidence of a true superstar. Just watch as your star power outshines everyone and everything.
A simple medical bandage, nothing out of the ordinary. But sometimes, even the most ordinary things can bring relief from pain.

A cute little hat that emits the charming aroma of vanilla and cream, helping to calm the nerves and provide relaxation. However, upon learning that this thing isn't edible, most of its <nobr>mood-altering</nobr> effects are immediately negated.

Need help with your homework? We've got you covered! By incorporating live Kraken neurons into a pliable fabric medium, we've created a glove that makes your hands as flexible as an octopus with three missing tentacles.
An exaggerated velvet hat that gives the wearer the air of a mysterious, elegant, magnificent and noble street performer.

A silver ring in the shape of a crescent moon, originally used in various transformation rituals. When the arcanist who made it accidentally inserted a real cat's eye instead of a cat's eye opal, the ring's effect was drastically altered.
One of the essential items that Zeno Arms Academy provides to its internal staff. Please make sure that you don't take someone else's canteen by mistake, as the contents could be a nasty surprise.

A favorite of old country farmers, it always seems to have extra grains to shake out. Although as magical as the goose that laid the golden eggs, it wasn't chosen as the subject of a fairy tale because of its mundane nature.

A ring that doesn't actually contain emeralds. This piece is actually a protective talisman that a father made for his daughter before she went on a long journey. Even though it was made of cheap materials, its value is priceless.
A fancy short velvet cape. The magician cannot use it to cover his sleight of hand, and must flick it away from time to time so that it doesn't interfere with the performance.

Gleaned from the murmurs of the jungle on the cusp of winter and spring. The incantation acquired from the processing of this essence is a pale turquoise and contains secrets that are subsequently bottled and sprayed.

Due to the availability of raw materials and simple production method involved in their creation, vendors often hoard many unsold rabbit feet, bundling them together and labeling them as "giant mutant rabbit feet" to deceive inexperienced buyers.
Frog skin is one of the most forgiving materials around. It will take your snotty tissues, expired chewing gum, and broken shell casings without a single complaint.

A drunkard once bragged about his military exploits and produced this as "physical evidence. According to him, he once infiltrated an enemy camp alone and captured some important information... but he can't seem to remember the name of that particular battle.
Cursed by its wearer, who was tormented by cheap, itchy fabric, anyone who touches this hat will feel its stinging pain.

A furry, soft thing. It is said to bring good luck and allows you to fight on the front lines unharmed, but it's more likely that its cute and harmless appearance inspires compassion in the hearts of the enemy.
A rusty iron "bow" with dents and scratches all over it. Maybe the person who skillfully twisted this strip of metal into this shape just wanted a nice red bow.
The most effective element of this thing is the leftover Critter fur inside—when rubbed against the wearer's hair, it produces an amazing amount of static electricity.

The most controversial accessory in the Screaming Tide series. Despite having a texture that feels like it is always soaked in water (a feature that most buyers find difficult to endure), it has gained widespread acclaim among arcanists of the water monster and sea beast bloodlines.
Don't be stingy with kindness—give your opponents a big smile! They're working so hard to stop you, but in vain...

Part of the "Law of the Jungle" accessory series. This series is designed to reflect the notions of wildness, sensuality, and power, with each accessory embodying a different concept. This particular piece symbolizes "Opportunity."

A <nobr>custom-made</nobr> folder from Hungary, delicately designed and finely crafted. Surprisingly, it's not full of documents, but instead is loaded with various Ritual Disks that serve as a testament to the struggles of an arcanist who cannot use arcane skills.
Made in Denmark, when lit it creates a variety of pleasant and uplifting illusions. This piece no doubt has the power to generate a fiery fighting spirit among pipe owners.

A quality choice for unlocking your potential and strengthening your resolve. Allergy sufferers should use with caution as excessive dust may cause adverse reactions such as incantations being interrupted by sneezing.
A pouch with a tendency to regurgitate whatever is stuffed into it. Maybe that is why this poor thing always seems to be hungry.
The work of a bored arcanist after eating a can of sardines. Because the fish heads completely block the wearer's vision, they provide the wearer with supreme confidence when facing strong enemies.
All fire incantations gain DMG Dealt +10%.
All fire incantations gain DMG Dealt +20%. After casting a fire incantation, grant +1 Moxie to a random ally.
All fire incantations gain DMG Dealt +40%. After casting a fire incantation, grant Moxie +1 to 2 random allies.
All fire incantations gain DMG Dealt +80%. After casting a fire incantation, grant Moxie +1 to all allies.
All fire incantations gain DMG Dealt +160%. After casting a fire incantation, grant Moxie +5 to all allies.
Is this phone really connected? It's me, boss.
Are you returning that box of fake tickets? Oh, it's already too late now.
Late? What, are they giving you a hard time?
You know what those gangbangers are like. It all started out so simple. I sold them some fake tickets, and they gave me some "benefits."
They know you were the one who stole—who took that box of tickets and cost them a bunch of money.
I'm no mug—I wouldn't wait for them to come find trouble with me. I haven't even opened the stall these past few days. Best to lie low till things blow over.
As for that box of fake tickets, do whatever you want with it.
I actually came here to ask about those tickets...
Do you know who else they've got selling tickets for them?
I want to scoop up all those fake tickets and make sure they don't end up in the hands of unsuspecting sports fans.
So, are these Uluru Games really gonna happen? The last time I saw you, I remember you were busy figuring out how to make a clean break with that <nobr>rag-tag</nobr> squad.
That's not important anymore. You can't stay mad forever, right? I can't tell you too much about it—everything's still up in the air right now.
So, can you help me dig up some info? Do me this favor, and you might just be able to drag yourself out of the darkness and into the light for once.
Sure, I have my ways. I'll keep my ear to the ground and let you know what's going on with those fake tickets.
Remember to let me know as soon as you hear anything. I'm gonna snatch up all of those tickets in one go before they hit the market!
Gran, have look at this fire! Look! I think it's talking... and it's floating!
Is that... the Sacred Flame of Uluru? It's her! It's really her!
So the rumors are true—the Uluru Games really are back.
Her? Uluru... Sacred Flame? What are you on about?!
She must be even older than my grandmother, dear... She's the Sacred Flame of the Uluru Games.
It was a grand event of the arcanists, held every year at the mystical Uluru Rocklands.
Did you go to the Uluru Games to watch the show, Grandma?
Yes, I did. I'll remember it for the rest of my days. I still remember... the first time I watched the <nobr>torch-lighting</nobr> ceremony. Your old grandmother was about the same age you are now.

The entire stadium was packed with people. Once that torch was lit, the cheers and applause went on and on, and every last person in the audience felt like their heart was about to jump out of their chests.
But one day, the games just stopped, and half a century passed in the blink of an eye. That war dragged the whole civilized world into a mire along with this flame.
Half a century? She was gone for that long? And now, she's back?!
It looks like the rumors were true. The Uluru Games really are back.
Ezra, what's that you're looking at?
Ah... Professor. This... I suppose this can be considered extracurricular reading material.
Dr. Crawford's "Reincarnator Chronicles" is quite an abstruse treatise. I thought you might find it a little hard to digest. Very impressive, Ezra.
Indeed... It's a bit difficult to understand. I had to spend some time searching for information to help me get it all, but it's all very interesting, of course.
Administrator Sophie told me that this book was last borrowed three years ago.
Let me take a look at the lending records. Hah! This last borrower's name was David W— Huh? Professor, was it you?
Haha! You should always read the works of your senior peers at the earliest opportunity.
I used to work in the same lab as Crawford, but our research was focused on very different fields.
I like dealing with plants, while he is obsessed with sociology and enjoys interacting with the people around him.
You really know him? Is he an arcanist?
An arcanist? No, he's human, no different from the two of us.
Sorry, professor... What I mean is, reincarnators only crop up in arcanist bloodlines, don't they?

Ah, so that's what you're worried about. Ezra, all surgeons are grateful for Roentgen's discovery of <nobr>X-rays</nobr>, regardless of bloodline. When it comes to the many fields of science, there are no divisions that cannot be bridged.
And for researchers, there exist no divisions between different fields of research that our love for knowledge cannot overcome.
Do you mean I can also consider pursuing reincarnators as my own field of research?
<nobr>M-My</nobr> dear friends! Erm... <nobr>H-Have</nobr> you read the latest issue of the Nagger...?
Of course. I'm always keen to see what lies those lowlifes will come up with next.
Yes, that's right! Lies! It's all lies!
Look... Just look! Look at me, just like a frisbee—my floating <nobr>DUU-DUU</nobr>-BELL-BOO! Can you imagine this being the outfit of an alien spy?
Please rest assured, Mr. aliEn T. We both are rotatable circular objects, so I am naturally inclined to believe what you say.
Actually... you can't say it's not suspicious at all.
Ah... But the Naggers, who's so confident about "alien invaders", isn't exactly the most reliable source.

When will that rag publish something that even remotely resembles the truth? They also called me a prime example of young people today being crushed by the pressures of the housing crisis! What a load of crock!

Yeah... That's right! It's all a big conspiracy orchestrated by those stinky <nobr>sock-wearers</nobr> at the Aerial Survey Office... Another ridiculous footnote in an absurd battle of office politics!
I... I appreciate the fact that you trust me! Really!
Don't worry too much, my friend.
No lie lasts forever. Everything has to come to an end at some point, and sometimes, we have to take care of the big problems before the little ones sort themselves out.
Hmm... I never imagined a UFO would cause such an uproar. To be frank, I'm quite shocked by all this.
Just lay low and it'll blow over in no time.
Dessie, my sweet pea. Your friends can never keep up with you on the track.
They're all just too slow, Grandma. I can't just stop running and wait for them...
You're developing a lot faster than other children the same age as you, and your P.E. teacher says you might have what it takes to be a star of track and field one day.
Well... it just means sports like running, jumping, and throwing things as far as you can.
Won't I hit someone if I go around throwing things?
Hah! No you won't hit anyone. If you managed to do that, you'd become a track and field legend on the spot.
Hmm... It doesn't really sound like much of a challenge.
You have many other options open to you. You can do anything, little bird.
You can be a poet or a painter. You can go be a singer.
There are countless choices for you to explore in life. If you truly understand the worth of your talents, you can also become an athlete.
When you walk along the wall, it's like you're flying—like gravity has no hold over you.
Can Plappy be an athlete, too? It can run just as fast as me.
Hah! Then, my child, you should go up for a dressage competition. That way, you and Plappy will become unbeatable partners and work together to take home a gold medal.
Oh... Your grandma's getting senile in her old age. I forgot—that era ended long ago. Sporting competitions for arcanists have been missing from the world for a long time now.
I don't know if we'll ever see the day the Uluru Games are held once again...
Grandma, you're always there, in my mind.
Please watch over me. The day we talked about is finally here.
You were right. Plappy and I have become unbeatable partners.
A tooth that won't stop chattering. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Always take good care of it and use it immediately after it is opened. Don't be surprised by these little ones' speed when they flee: they were freaked out before running away from the gum.
A viscous fluid of moss green coloration with the smell of rotten mint. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.

You trembled in your dreams and suddenly woke up with a scream. They were running across your skin. Made with cracked teeth, the liquefaction has improved its stability and shelf life. Tasting it is not recommended as it brings more than just nightmares.
A strange, heavy box. People claim to have heard strange noises from it. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
You won't be able to tell where it comes from, whom it belongs to or why it looks so strange. More importantly, you will never know what you have released.
"Monster ... MOM! HELP! THERE'S A MONSTER UNDER MY BED!" Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.

Your children are right about the Bogeyman. As a parent, you better keep an eye out for these wicked kidnappers. But they can be lucrative. Catch one and it might help pay the bills because we're buying them! Call <nobr>098-1937</nobr>**21 for details.
Unrefined magnesia salt. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
It's not quite useful in <nobr>high-level</nobr> rituals. The seller promised that the part that looks like a human face was but a coincidence created by nature.
Refined magnesia salt. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Usable in exorcism and purification rites. It may not be important, but we can't do without it.
A mandrake herb. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
A mandrake that does not scream? That must be the greatest thing in the history of Arcanum! Robert the Magnesia made a fortune with this and now lives in his very own manor.
An extremely rare material from Harappa. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
A dried arm of a primate. Don't wish for anything from it, and that includes silent wishes as well.
A pile of broken bones. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Careful, this may be sharp. Of course, only fools will hurt themselves with this ... WHOA! Watch out!
A rather intact set of bones but the pieces are taken from different animals. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Though not as superior as a full skeleton, the femur, ribs, and pieces of the skull are the optimal solution you can afford.
A skeleton with 2 skulls. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
What did the humans say again? Oh, what a poor, deformed little thing! But guess what the arcanists say. Oh my, look at these sublime features only evident in the noblest of all blood lines!
Skeleton of the dragon. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
Dragons, the true cryptid. A living dragon commands majestic power, while a dead one is still a trove of riches.
Raw silver ore. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Precious metal can be extracted from these ores. It is also a casting medium for some basic arcane skills.
A handcrafted silver ingot with a rough surface. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
A tad unrefined but still serviceable. Use it to cast arcane skills or buy a jar of jelly beans or cookies. The choice is yours.

Polished silver bullions. The consecration ritual makes them as brightly reflective as a mirror. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Everybody loves a pretty bullion of silver. Being washed in holy water not only gave them a beauteous sheen, but also powerful arcane energy and exorcist properties.
Patterned silver bullets that contain immense power. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
It takes effort to make one, but it's definitely worth it. No matter if your target is a vampire or a werewolf, it will come in handy.
An enchanted broom. Comes with a manual of 100 Spells of Banishing. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
It can take care of both thorough and daily cleaning. All it takes is a bit of money and your hands will be freed forever. What's more cheering than that?
A rabbit's foot and a wrinkled piece of order paper. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Nobody would have thought that this item is the secret to good luck. The story of its origin begins with Marianna who worked at a family diner ...
A glass bird that sings no songs. Keep away from heat and avoid mishandling. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
An arcanist's best friend! Let this little birdie remember your spells for you. With over 5241 practical spells in its memory bank, this is the <nobr>go-to</nobr> choice for busy arcanists!
The most dangerous and hazardous book to the best of your knowledge. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.

You will get to read the most hidden, forbidden and forgotten spells in history among the mad words of this book. He is the best tutor for all the ambitious villains. Just remember one thing: ask only, and never answer.
An ancient coin. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
Embark on a journey, or wait plainly.
An expensive pendulum. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
An ouija board used by the most legendary mediums. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters. Also used as the material for crafting advanced materials.
It shall purge things that lead you astray.
But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
It is the rebel vanguard for the disobedient and those who seek knowledge.
It never swore an oath. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
It is the edge for the weak, the silent, and the belittled.
Thousands died in the sea seeking it. Used for Insight or Resonate rituals of characters.
It is a reward for the adventurous and the bravest souls.
A tattered page. Used for the ritual of Mineral Insight I.
They are buried deep under the mountain rocks where a gem is indistinguishable from bits of coal.
Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Mineral Insight II.
The rock spits on those with a weak mind. It is the code between instant and eternity.
A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Mineral Insight III.
A titan's child that emerged from a weeping wound of the Earth vein. It is a steadfast guardian and an indestructible friend. Even the nobles would bow before this sonorous herald.
A tattered page. Used for the ritual of Star Insight I.
Neither the moon nor the sun could rob it of its colors.
Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Star Insight II.
It breeds infants and helps them sleep in peace. It is a friend of lengthy nights and fantasies.
A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Star Insight III.
An omen, a filthy secret, or an act of absolute vileness. You can also treat it as a handful of broken glass on black satin.
A tattered page. Used for the ritual of Plant Insight I.
To reach the skies, its roots grow deep into the earth to extract nourishments from decomposed life.
Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Plant Insight II.
It shall keep growing till it smothers the entire sky, till it chokes every single space, till the deep green tide blankets everything in sight.
A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Plant Insight III.
It is the source of every twig in the deep woods, every strand of moss and floating weed and the mother of every tree. All of them know you.
A tattered page. Used for the ritual of Beast Insight I.
They wept and they cried. They lived and they died.
Incomplete scrolls. Used for the ritual of Beast Insight II.
They walked in the barrens, resting in the day and rising in the night.
A heavy tome. Used for the ritual of Beast Insight III.
Their every breath feels like that of their mother's mother and their father's father. They see what the mortals see.
A hardly noticeable sinuous howl. Mostly seen in the important resonate rituals. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
When the dappled shade of the tree falls on the ground, when the dried branch cracks under your feet, when the birds are scared away by the sinuous howl, you find it there.
A hardly noticeable shudder interlaced like teeth. Mostly seen in the important resonate rituals. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
When the suspension bridge is crumbling between the cliffs, when the man with tingling ears is walking on a wire, when the interlaced shudders cannot be stopped, you find it there.
A hardly noticeable indistinguishable murmur. Mostly seen in the important resonate rituals. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
When the traveler stands at a deserted fork, when the hurricane takes the sand away, when the hypocritical murmur is haunting the skull, you find it there.
A hardly noticeable weak echo. Mostly seen in the important resonate rituals. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
When tears are shed and eyes are closed at midnight, when a sigh cannot be ignored in one's solitude, when the hoarse echo sinks into the deep sea, you find it there.
An obvious sign of restlessness. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
In your drenched dreams, in the shadowed paths you strolled alone, at the moment sudden restlessness shivers up your spine, you find it there.
A cacophony that follows you like a shadow. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
Over the bonfire that burns moths into charred ash, in the ephemeral silence among the cheers of the crowd, through the brief cacophony that stores within the embrace, you find it there.
An unending vibration. A material for leveling up Character Resonance.
On the stalker that has been tailing you, on the strange face that greets you on the other side of the mirror, in the sonorous knell that sends deafening reverberations, you find it there.
Both familiar and unknown faces can be seen on those black negatives. Used for character Portrait.
The crescent and the oak tree taught her how to listen to everything in the woods.
The witch above the Barents Sea sends you her regards. She's not into slow tours.
Someone is always willing to be fooled and wear that ridiculous ass head. How moving and touching! His love is even deeper than the sea.
One day she'll realize that being herself is already enough for her to soar in the skies.
Justice, mercy, and glory. He has already taken these codes to heart.
Books are not the only source of knowledge which one can learn from. She still has a long, long way to go.
Sometimes, he has to shed some blood for the sake of others. Fortunately, he has machines to do that for him.
Hush, listen closely. This is an insignificant little secret.
The fool on stage knows that nobody needs a clown in this time.
The poet and his animal friends lead a carefree life on a desolate island beyond the sweeping tundras of Siberia.
Leaving home, bidding farewell to her family, and remembering the tastes and prices of 143 types of wine have never been easy, but she's always laboring away.
This is his best friend, his closest kin, his blood, his curse, and his life.
Beth left. Angelina left. Tommy left. Even that Alice left. But don't worry. She'll stay here.
A challenger of authority and fate. Though she's skilled in playing a tyrant's role, she acts in the way of a benevolent ruler.
Just like the fog of London, there is no end to duty. The heavy hat still stands and the routine work never halts.
Like a vile gossiper she listened to secrets. Like a dreamer with hope she listened to the beautiful things of this world.
Every transgressor of justice shall face justice's verdict.
She had recited countless poems in silence, yet none of the authors could give her the answer she wanted.
She gives out balloons and attends parties. "Greetings to you! Hi there! Salutations!" she would say.
The beam will be transmitted via the arc. Where does it end? Well, rock and roll never ends.
Blood will have blood. Bestial claws tore the old moon to pieces as the mothers wept tears that flowed like rivers.
Welcome to radio news! We have everything you want to know right here on this channel!
He firmly believes that light is a kind of particle. Most of his theories have been proven correct, and he's not completely wrong this time.
Perhaps this should not have happened. Perhaps you still have a chance to bring her back to the Orange Orchard.
Keep wishing. It has never worked anyway.
Why should a good kid like this suffer? This isn't fair.
Give her more surprises, dangers, and extraordinary experiences. This is the only way to keep her around.
The bodiless are still different from souls, but apparently she would like to talk about something else.
No matter what happens, she always greets you with open arms. "Aloha!"
She comes from the future. She knows what the future has in store for her.
She bends over to listen to the sighs of the deceased, and bestows meaning upon their lives.
A <nobr>self-abased</nobr> yet tenacious sakura petal, and a heart which has found where it belongs.
Believe in science. Of course chocolate can drive away the evils for you.
Hey! Hey! Hello! Hello! Goodbye! Goodbye!
Atop the world, be the distinguished one to look down at everything with pride!
He still remembered love, before he forgot everything.
Those words are sweeter than candy, those "diamonds" are more dazzling than the stars, and they all belong to you, as long as you don't mind they are just lies.
She knows well that there are more kinds of humans than glaze colors. She would rather be a guide than be a shaper.
This is the 125th time she falls, and the 126th time she stands up in the camera.
Don't look at her, or ignore her. Don't remember her, or forget her.
Completely different from those fettered by the rules, they are the most useful one. That's enough.
Collecting all the notes and melodies on her way, she decided to let the violin express her.
He records the truest side of everything, through the camera, and the incontrovertible courage.
He is great, he is towering, and he creaks. The wind after him smells like carrot.
Life starts and ends in a surging blue wave, and she drinks it.
Times will be eventually changed and reborn. The new era is like an obedient puppy by her feet.
A tooth and a song drift into children's dreams, sweet as golden wing dust.
People always focus on that head, just like how they always stare at the absurdity above the truth. She will reveal them one day, both of them.
It was a long journey, and she names it "The Way Home."
She dreamed of <nobr>far-flung</nobr> greenery and deep, deep lakes. Her eyes now open wide, she's no longer alone.
Please try to keep everything in order ... Please.
She will step on the stairs to Valhalla, in the story, in her dream, and in the future.
Watch out, don't get yourself hurt by the sharp reflection of reality.
Discos, parties, trendy hair bands, and nail polish—a secret notebook for her crayons, stories, and heart.
Cheers to logic, but also to Kensington syrup, ghosts, and taking the road less traveled.
She has taken enough pictures of her different spoils to put together a thick album. But she's always ready for more.
This is an adorable Border Collie loved by many, a good boy who never binge on strawberry cookies, a deep thinker pondering nihilism.
For artists as rebellious and progress as he is, the path lies ahead of them is always bumpy. People praise the new arts, but seldomly protect its creators.

A unique thread that was never spun. It can spin the Spinning Wheel 1 time.
Used in character summoning.
The golden rabbit is a well known myth. It spies on people, steals their time, and sometimes even changes their fates. Though it's old, decrepit, and stale, it is unique and indispensable.
A thread with ten unique, perfect qualities. Can be used to Summon x10.
The storyteller never thought that golden rabbits could travel in packs. Nobody knows what this might entails, but no one chooses one single rabbit over more of it.
A mysterious organism that feeds on electrical conductors. Used to get 2x stage drops.

The dalpobeast can often be found around electrical conductors. Some claimed to have witnessed these creatures devouring electricity. Such moments may seem incredulous, but the sudden spike in power suggests this is more than just a hallucination.
A rare Dalpobeast. Used to get 4x stage drops.

People delving in the field of arcanum have spent fortunes on them. Everybody wants one, but it could never be truly owned by anyone. They would appear and disappear without warning, leaving a patch of "rare materials" behind.

A moment seized in a picture, a fragment of a time gone by, a precious souvenir. This is a token of friendship in memory of the adventures you shared together.
Use it as your portrait in your profile.
In the "Storm," she has witnessed the end of many eras. And she is about to witness more.
When your think back to what has happened ... The memory always brings you great joy.
Under the moon, a blade gleams a steely gray. In the forest, the deer frolic, laugh, and play.
A famous theft. Many guesses were made about it.
A famous theft. Nobody knows what exactly happened in that ridiculous night. Except for you.
She has long awaited you with bated breath.
She has long awaited you with bated breath, to rouse the dreaming friend in the forest depths.
Low frequency polarization. Scattered polarization which is not enough to form images. A <nobr>low-level</nobr> material used for ascending a Psychube's level limit.

Polarization whose extremely low amplitude makes it unobservable. It is mainly generated by stable mental images. It reaches the peak in <nobr>1-3</nobr> hours after the image is formed, and starts to vanish in <nobr>12-15</nobr> days.
Medium frequency polarization, the weak polarization which is not enough for forming images. A <nobr>mid-level</nobr> material used for ascending Psychube's level limit.
This polarization of low amplitude can be seen continually when observed. It is mainly generated by <nobr>long-lasting</nobr>, mild mental images, such as sorrow and nostalgia.
High frequency polarization, the gathered polarization which is not enough for forming images. A <nobr>high-level</nobr> material used for ascending Psychube's level limit.

This polarization has high amplitude and is easy to observe, but it is less often seen compared to MF Polarization. It is mainly generated by strong and temporary mental images, such as anger, impulse and greed.
Extreme high frequency polarization, the boiling polarization which is not enough for forming images. The <nobr>highest-level</nobr> material used for ascending Psychube's level limit.

Rare polarization of extremely high amplitude. It is mainly generated by extremely unstable mental images. Whoever sees it must centrifuge it immediately and inform the head of the department as soon as possible.
The priest who symbolizes harvest. Used to level up all parts of the Paleohall.
Some people believe the Kern Baby is a prop for evil witchcraft which brings harvest by plundering. No, that's not true. In the Wilderness where there is nothing, harvest is only a gift of good luck.
The high priest who symbolizes harvest. Used to level up all parts of the Paleohall.

People no longer see her as a plunderer. They compliment her wholeheartedly on her garland, and even everything about her. The Wilderness will eventually achieve prosperity, as a result of her generosity.
The underground rock that brings harvest. Used to level up the Paleohall.
It shares the same heart beats with this land. Hope rises from the ground as soon as it is unearthed.
A suitcase from which faint music could be heard. Open it to get a <nobr>6-star</nobr> Psychube of your choice.
A case keeping all the tuned rhythms which once lingered on the ocean.
A glass bottle containing tattered pages which you have never seen before. Open it to get an archival Page of your choice. Used for Insight of characters.
"I pursue wisdom. It is the pleasure it brings that I want, not the fame."
A casket which all arcanists are familiar with. Open it to get a <nobr>low-level</nobr> material of your choice used for character Insight or Resonate.
No matter you need it or not, it is not something valuable.
A casket which all arcanists are familiar with. Open it to get a <nobr>mid-level</nobr> material of your choice used for Insight or Resonate.
You know what you want. Though it looks plain, it can always meet your pressing need.
A casket which all arcanists are familiar with. Open it to get a <nobr>high-level</nobr> material of your choice used for Insight or Resonate.
What you have been longing for eagerly. Now it's yours.
A metal container that seals scrolls. Open it to get an archival Scroll of your choice. Used for Insight of characters.
"I've grown too tall and lonely ... I'm waiting for ... Who am I waiting for?"
A wooden casket that stores Resonance crystals. Open it to get an advanced Resonance crystal of your choice to use for leveling up Character Resonance.
The whispers inside are overflowing. Seize the opportunity when you get to hear them.
A package which all arcanists are familiar with. Open it to get a random <nobr>low-level</nobr> material used for Insight or Resonate.
A small surprise you occasionally have in life.
A package which all arcanists are familiar with. Open it to get a random <nobr>mid-level</nobr> material used for character Insight or Resonate.
It deserves a round of applause and cheers.
A wooden casket that stores Resonance crystals. Open it to get a random <nobr>advanced</nobr> Resonance crystal to use for leveling up Character Resonance.
The whispers inside are overflowing. Maybe one of them belongs to you.
A package which all arcanists are familiar with. Open it to get a random <nobr>high-level</nobr> material used for Insight or Resonate.
Often seen at the finale of an adventure story, which is the best moment to cheer.
"If it won't come out the first time, then we should try again." One more try! I have the feeling it's coming!
A mysterious box. Open it to get the following <nobr>low-level</nobr> materials used for Insight or Resonate.
Pick it when you hesitate between the items.
A mysterious box. Open it to get the following <nobr>mid-level</nobr> materials used for Insight or Resonate.
A selected gift with the most sincere and undecorated wishes.
A mysterious box. Open it to get the following <nobr>high-level</nobr> materials used for Insight or Resonate.
A wish secretly made, a secret hidden in the corner, and a treasure lost in time. All of them are undoubtedly hard to find.
Use to unlock higher decibel level in Roar Jukebox.
The rewards come along with the noise that Roar Jukebox creates are just as abundant as the torture it brings. Still, countless arcanists strive to be tortured by it — Endure and then enjoy.

A smattering of <nobr>voice-sensitive</nobr> components. They can help Doggie better understand Pickles's language. Collect them to get more rewards from [Pickles's Free Translation].
Can only be used during the [The Theft of the Rimet Cup] event.
For revamp, <nobr>scale-up</nobr>, and upgrades. They are not as complicated as they sound.
A medication used for interrogations. It can be turned in as a task item in story trails.
Get rid of the lips of guile and tongue of lies, and truth will be all that remains.
A key for a door waiting to be opened. It can be turned in as a task item in story trails.
A delicate, fragile key that hardly fits this door. A single turn might break it. The key has inscriptions that read "It's time."
A restaurant leaflet. It can be turned in as a task item in story trails.

A leaflet with all the fancy words. It introduces Manches Vertes's new dishes for tonight: French enamel stew in liquid gold, dollar pie with gold foil, and the most anticipated secret dish, Beautiful New Dream.
A key to the gate entwined by thorns. It can be turned in as a task item in story trails.
A key whose style fits the door's. Light and slightly warm, it was once shrouded in smoke and the smell of gas.
An acorn used to awaken the blurred memory about an oak. It can be turned in as a task item in story trails.
A hard brown nut with refreshing scent and a long history.
A toy used to awaken the blurred memory about a puppy. It can be turned in as a task item in story trails.
The funny crown and the ceramic touch make it different from the moist and living image in the memory.
Someone's treasured notebook. The answer to a riddle.
The story grew alone, like damp moss creeping quietly over a tree's roots.
A key that unlocks an unknown door.
Old and plain, it smells of sodden soil. Remember, do not open the last door—What do you mean this is an old parable?
We all yearn for wealth and satisfaction. Use to get a small bag of Sharpodonty.
"A few Sharpodonty specimens live in the wild. Their fierce appearance is an act designed to hide their docile nature. You just need some time to reveal their true self."
We all yearn for wealth and satisfaction. Use to get a modest amount of Sharpodonty.
"The lengthy process of domestication will gradually make the creatures more gentle. Indeed, you must believe that the occasional fits of feral rage are just a misunderstanding."
We all yearn for wealth and satisfaction. Use to get a large pile of Sharpodonty.
"Once tamed, they will be as inert as what the 'Negotiated Peace' requests. They shall exist like a silent empire in the world of arcanists."
A capsule derived from a <nobr>well-proven</nobr> experiment result. Contains a small amount of Dust to level up characters.
We've done everything we could, but it simply refuses to assume absolute stability. Accidents may happen. You have been warned.
Stable encapsulated gel made with the latest formula. Contains a modest amount of Dust for leveling up rituals.

Under special circumstances, the Dust that escapes will continue to surround the capsule. It has been identified that the Dust Capsule in this state is more beneficial for arcanists, but apparently it is not stable enough.
A box of capsules made with a special recipe. Contains a generous serving of Dust to level up characters.

An extremely rare Dust Capsule of a special kind. The Dust particles are kept in a state of extraordinarily violent <nobr>micro-reactions</nobr>. However, both of the status and emotion of the capsule remain extremely stable, allowing it to maintain a relatively rigid structure.
A notebook with quite a lot of information scrawled in it. Unlocks the "Clue" feature.
Conclude, connect, deduce. On to the next one.
A note written in messy handwriting. If deciphered, it could reveal a Green Lake campsite anecdote.
Written by a hand unpracticed in holding a pen. The smell of moss clings to the page. A story about "it".
Written by a hand unpracticed in holding a pen. The smell of moss clings to the page. A story about "him".
Written by a hand unpracticed in holding a pen. The smell of moss clings to the page. A story about "her".

A lucky star that has touched the astrolabe. Can be used to part the veils of Fate in Vedic Astrology.
Can only be used during the [Journey to Mor Pankh] event.
A distinct darkness through which you catch a glimpse of intelligence.
A bright patch of moisture through which you catch a glimpse of sensibility.
A pure perfection through which you catch a glimpse of inspiration.
A scorching order through which you catch a glimpse of courage.
An otherworldly philosophy through which you catch a glimpse of karma.
A lasting practice of faith through which you catch a glimpse of dedication.
Everything in Chandigarh is tailored to its people. The Open Hand beckons even as it proclaims its singularity alongside its hopes for the future.
A city designed with as much care as Mankind was created with, a <nobr>brand-new</nobr> roadmap guided by the ideas of the Athens Charter was born with Novum Caput.

The ancient observatory is situated here, serving as both a mailbox and a beacon.
The sky always whispers back when I look up at it, like innumerable elders looking out for me.
I stare and stare, making out the features of the cosmos with my feeble mortal eyes.

A field of darkness extinguished, a <nobr>broken-down</nobr> caravan. She smooths out the crumpled pages of the book with her small, callused hand, which is a proof of the <nobr>pocket-picking</nobr> business. Again, and then again.
He closes his eyes, but the breathing of the wolf does not fade as the fire by his feet crackles merrily.

Wind harnesses it, stepping onto the boundless sea. 
It searches all continents and islands, yet returns in silence.

Wind passes through it, mooring at the shore of destiny. 
The tireless traveler leaves behind an everlasting monument.
"We are all just numbers when it comes down to it." Of this, she is utterly convinced.

You roam through time, passing by here.
The mudflat promises you that your memories will not be washed away.
A bookmark made from the wings of a cicada, delicate and handy. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
Please store the wings away from the body, preferably in a cool place. Occasional trembling is normal; just wait for it to dry completely.
Not every key is born with wings. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
Find an open space, hold the key handle firmly, and mentally recite your destination. It will lead you to the keyhole, in the form of a bird.
A moth that's noticed the faint light within itself. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
Please do not stimulate the light source at its tail. Handle gently to avoid burning.
A cog that won't stop turning. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
All the secrets of time are hidden in the ceaseless turning of the gears.
A component shaped like an elegant goose neck. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
It bends its neck to take up the balance spring of the clock, take up precision, take up time itself.
The word "Precision" is inscribed inside. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters.
Through polishing, inlaying, and fine carving, one can obtain a lively "heart."
The shell of a beetle turned into a beautiful pendant. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
They discern directions through the moisture of the soil and the change of light, looking forward to their moment of maturation.
A weathered compass. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters. Also usable as a material for crafting advanced materials.
It will remove the wrong paths for you.
The oar of the River of Dreams that once hypnotized a giant. Used in Insight and Resonance rituals for characters.
Mediating peace between those in dispute and hostility.
The world is a mathematical equation; to her, that is enough.
This is the duty of a perfect number, day after day. Fate runs its course, day after day.
A geometric ornament that someone lost. It can be submitted as a task item in story trails.
It has never been caught in the tide, but now it is moist.

Purchase to get Decatone - [The First Milestone]. Can be used to Summon x10 in [Abundance of the Water].
<color=#AC5320>Usable in [Abundance of the Water: The First Milestone] summoning event. </color> <color=#AC5320>Expires when the event ends.</color>
Gentleness, trendiness, and progressiveness are virtues unique to rabbits. They happily push the spinning wheel, round and round, until your heart is content.
A peculiar and mysterious magnesium light. Used to unlock challenges in Anecdotes. Resets after the event, requires consumption of Activity to reactivate during the next Anecdote.
In the pervasive fog interspersed with murmurs, it has nowhere to escape the magnesium light.
She can catch the brightest spark—any time, any place.
Spores fall, the umbrella opens. Agaricomycetes and Dacrymycetes. We're the same, you and I.
Run, run again, jump over the ledger, the schedule, and the finish line, and you'll reach their warm home.
Forever they burn—the flames of peace and competition will never be extinguished.
I see it. Hot and glowing like bird eggs on a campfire. I touched it—it was blazing, like fire.
I know, this is a dream only recently born.
A moment seized in a picture, a fragment of a time gone by, a precious souvenir. This is a token of friendship in memory of the adventures you shared together.
Crossing rainforests, deserts, mountains, and seas. We arrive as promised, you and I, two beating hearts.
Do not stop, do not falter. Keep moving forward until the soles of your shoes wear thin, until your strength fades, until your breath runs out.
She studies every smiling face, contemplating the true essence of the word "ask."
Tall trees can block out the sun, just as large wings can. However, the wearer of these wings seldom takes flight.
The thick mist slowly dissipates, revealing the sound of footsteps getting closer ...
As the last remnants of fog dissipate, it reveals itself, standing motionless in utter stillness.
As the sun rises, a piece of music is released from its cocoon, filling the brightening path with its melody.
Your most loyal and faithful bottle. Open it to get a <nobr>5-star</nobr> character of your choice.This item will expire at <color=#AC5320>5:00 am. on December 19, 2023.</color>
A carefully chosen gift that fulfills a modest wish. It may not meet all your expectations, but it still has room to grow.

A unique thread that can spin the Spinning Wheel 1 time in the [Till the Last Drop] summoning event.
<color=#AC5320>Exclusive for summoning characters from the [Till the Last Drop] summoning event.</color> After the <nobr>time-limited</nobr> [Till the Last Drop] summoning event ends, <color=#AC5320>this item will expire.</color>
The rabbit is still a rabbit. Though it shimmers strangely and conspicuously, it's still your dear friend. Fashionable, lively, longing for the lake and knowing that you feel the same.

A unique and perfect thread that can spin the Spinning Wheel 10 times in the [Till the Last Drop] summoning event.
<color=#AC5320>Exclusive for summoning characters from the [Till the Last Drop] summoning event.</color> After the <nobr>time-limited</nobr> [Till the Last Drop] summoning event ends, <color=#AC5320>this item will expire.</color>
Rabbits are always so quirky, busy, unpredictable. Now they have a new pleasure, greater than stealing time. Indeed, the legend of the golden rabbit lives on, and this is its latest chapter.
A sound that is both strange and familiar. Can be exchanged at the bank's [Limited Shop].

Those unique, elusive voices of new friends or even childhood strangers. They contain vague murmurs, a hummed tune, discussions of celestial bodies, lucky cards, or dinner ingredients. They rush by, harder to interpret, and all the more...alluring.
Hooves startle the water's veil, the breeze awakens the sleeper, drunkenly asking what time it is.
A strangely familiar metal box with rewards inside.
Harvests always appear out of nowhere, with a clacking sound and a fluffy smell. They maintain their amazement until the moment they pop up ... Remember, this is not a toaster, definitely not.
A popular confection in the world of arcanists. Restores 60 Cellular Activity.

The Picrasma tree is a deciduous plant with alternating arrangements of <nobr>eye-shaped</nobr>, coarsely dentate leaves. Nodes may be found in the middle of the leaf veins. Has a bitter taste. Flowering season depends on the climate of its location.
Now packed with more active ingredients and fewer additives. Restores 120 Cellular Activity.

After multiple attempts, researchers of Laplace Scientific Computing Center managed to create a stable and easy way to store the mixture of Picrasma leaves, cane sugar, and alcohol. Further experimentation on this topic is still ongoing.
In 1427 AD, an explorer found the Picrasma Tree and named it. The investigation on its original location is still ongoing nowadays.

The Picrasma tree was once classified as a useless plant due to its indescribable flavor. The plant only became more popular in the arcanum world after recent publications revealed its unique property of stimulating Cellular Activity.
A priceless arcanum currency. Can be used for summoning and item purchases.

The Storm arrived and the rain drops rose into the skies as though returning to their mother's embrace and the blistering hot cauldron from which they came. But accidents might just happen. If they fail to reach the other side before the Storm ends, they will fall back to the earth.
A priceless arcanum currency. Can be used for summoning or restoring Cellular Activity.

The quiet twin, the most reliable of the siblings, and the one always giving help to those in need. It is armed with every virtue. It is the last raindrop to rise, and the first to return to the earth.
An acceptable currency amongst the arcanists. Everyone needs some of this.
A currency from the ancient, unrecorded era. It has 13 edges and a maw of razor sharp teeth which only opens to those with arcanist blood.
A cell colony unique to the arcanists. The cell activity supports the application of common arcanist skills.

When a candidate activates their arcane skill, the activity of this cell colony will significantly increase. The capacity for signal transduction gradually decreases over time. The candidate's control over arcane skill will also be significantly reduced.
Echoes of the ultra law. Can be used for leveling up characters.

The glorious supreme law is nowhere to be found, but its power is great and beyond prediction. As it wanders, its dropping Dust also contains the energy for power increasing. It is, in a sense, part of the ultimate answer.
A track that has gone lost. Can be exchanged for items at the [Bass Counter] in the Bank.

Some people call it a tape, while more arcanists choose the name "Track of the Lost." It may have recorded a sad piece of rock music, an embarrassing monologue, a piece of white noise, or endless silence.
An album of tracks that have gone lost. Can be exchanged for items at the [Treble Counter] in the Bank.

The loudest and best Track of the Lost. This means more rock and roll and more soliloquies with barely changing moments of silence and white noise. Passionate fans will deliver the Track to its destination, but you must understand that they're not doing this pro bono.
An element of arcanist's thoughts. Can be exchanged for items at the [Psychube Shop] in the Bank.
There are so many ways to organize the mess: the furnace that burns, the blade that cuts ... but I wish to keep it the way it is.
A complete arcanist's thoughts. Can be exchanged for items at the [Psychube Shop] in the Bank.
As the disorganized has been organized, the darkened vision lightens, ideas are finally taking shape in my mind.
An insignificant dream meant to be forgotten. Can be exchanged for items in the [Oneiric Shop] in the Bank.

Snowflakes crushed by the wheels, pasture grass rustling in the wind, waves shattered against distant cliffs. Such sounds are insignificant but are recorded nonetheless. Again and again, till the very end.
A shell left in the Wilderness. Can be exchanged for items at the [Wilderness Shop] in the Bank.
A colorful, shiny shell placed in a chest. Coveted by many, it is usually covered with silk, and sometimes shroud.

A friendly reminder on the title page of FLASH:FAME which shows how many chances you have left to challenge yourself in UTTU Retails.
"UTTU Flash Gathering" only.
<color=#e47124>5 chances will be given at 5am each day.</color>
A clever reader knows when to pause. We are deeply encouraged if you had a good time reading the magazine; but it's always good to take a small break from it.

A receipt given by the UTTU Magazine. You may exchange items at "UTTU Shop" with it.
Only available during the event "UTTU Flash Gathering: Trophy of the Past Glory."
You earn it through hard work. The reward always comes with knowledge, insights, and patience.

Exchange items at "Rimet Cup" souvenir shop with it.
Only available during the event "The Theft of the Rimet Cup".

"Thank you for endorsing the newspaper industry." This commemorative coin is prepared for the readers who completed all the issues here. It's exquisitely made; you can keep it as a souvenir, or trade it for some interesting little things.
Indispensable survival provision. Exchange at the Treeshed Counter for a reward.
A camping essential packed with nutrients. Free from Arcanum additives, promise. Your tongue trembles sometimes when you chew it? You're just imagining things.
Consumables gathered from all over. Used to repair all sorts of Green Lake campsite equipment.
Dry, compact wood. This gift from the forest is lightweight, sturdy, and easy to work with. Take care when removing the tangled mycelium, and don't stare at the growth rings for too long.

A voucher from the UTTU magazine that can be exchanged at the UTTU Shop.
Can only be used during the "UTTU Flash Gathering - A Night Visit to the Lake" event.

An astrolabe that rotates forever on its own axis. Can be used in exchange for the Gift Shop of Kubera.
Can only be used during the [Journey to Mor Pankh] event.
At long last, each arc overlaps to form a plane and arrive at an answer. So much time has passed that it no longer matters.

A crystal that encases a dazzling light. Can be used to harken Whispers of the Sky.
Can only be used during the [Journey to Mor Pankh] event. Cannot be obtained after all whispers have been harkened to.
It may be a gift from the heavens, or the pursuit of fortune hunters. "Hark, a gift of intelligence from above!"

A receipt issued by UTTU Magazine. Can be exchanged for items at the [UTTU Shop].
Can only be used during the [UTTU Flash Gathering - The First Epic] event.
A steel canister carrying medicine and memories. Can be used to unlock "Anecdotes".
It contains one hundred milliliters of medicine, a square of foam floating next to a brown image, and <nobr>one-third</nobr> spoonful of time.
Back to tomorrow, back to the "Storm." Collect enough Tickets Home to claim rewards from the "Your <nobr>Long-lost</nobr> Friends" event.
Once dried by the sun, later soaked by the rain, these crumpled tickets now lie in your pocket, silently waiting for you to return for a new journey?

An Afflatus fragment made of a unique material. Can help 37 with making conjectures in [Black Box of Conjectures].
Usable only during the <color=#ac5320>[The Prisoner in the Cave]</color> event.
No one has ever been able to explain its origin and destination. Born from subtleties and vanishing between thoughts, like a fleeting halo in dense foam.

A receipt given by the UTTU Magazine. You may exchange items at "UTTU Market" with it.
Only available during the event "UTTU Flash Gathering: Wandering on the Shore."

A <nobr>copper-plated</nobr> coin with Mr. APPLe's portrait, used for repairing APPLe II.
Usable only during the "Set Sail Again" event.

The reconstruction of APPLe II is quite an undertaking that encompasses various aspects. As such, Regulus has minted this currency to quantify the rebuilding process—how useful it is is a matter of opinion.

Based on the current circumstances, this interpretation is hereby given in accordance with the relevant regulations and laws, in order to ensure the debates in the legislative process are carried out to serve its designated purpose, and the rights of the parties and interest groups involved are respected in the process.

Article 1 During the legislative debates, any member of the Joint Committee of the St. Pavlov Foundation who has doubt on the bill itself and requires explanation has the right to request an open debate from the chairperson. The chairperson in charge of the matter is obliged to accept this request.
...

Article 12 Within the 60 days of the legislative process and on the premise that all the parties are in compliance with the universally ratified Code of Conduct in the legislative period, both parties are entitled to an unlimited number of debates before the official voting on the bill and have the right to give up and withdraw from the debates.
Article 13 Termination of speech by either of the two parties will be considered as their withdrawal from the debate. The debate will hence end and the voting on the bill will be initiated. If the other party requests to continue with the speech, the Supreme Court will approve the proceeding of the debate. The debate will then last until that party requests voting or withdraw from the debate.
Article 14 Had no conclusion been drawn within 60 days, the Supreme Court shall determine the bill to be repealed. Any repealed bill will not be allowed to <nobr>re-enter</nobr> the legislative process within the next 5 years.
Article 15 In 10 days after the debate starts, both parties involved will be allowed to request voting to end the debate.
...

The Supreme Court will determine the bills which has less than two thirds of the votes to be repealed.

What Does Abstained Vote Mean And The Necessity of Abstention Ballot Box Abstained Vote is one of many forms of protest votes. It usually turns up next to an empty seat, inside a dustbin, between the washing machine and the wall, in the middle of a book, or in one of the inner pockets of an old jacket. It is the invalid vote cast because the voter has abstained from voting, and thus would not be counted into the election result. Different from other reasons which caused failure to vote, voters cast abstained votes because they neither approve nor disapprove of the available options of the voting. They may have swung between different answers, or even were once slightly more in favor of one motion/candidate over the rest of them, or hold a pessimistic opinion to all the options provided; whatever the reason might be, in the end, they decide to not support any motions/candidates in the election. Many have also argued that abstention from voting is, in fact, an action guided by a clear awareness of their given rights. As the subjects of rights, voters are entitled to the freedom not to vote. It is also argued by the same group of scholars that, when the voters are requested to choose between unfavorable options, it takes courage and determination to stay true to their own ideas and become the dissidents in this case. Such action is worthy of praise. They are individual thinkers who know what they need and are strong enough not to compromise. The Abstention Ballot Box is specially set up to count the votes of this group of people. It stands for a new possibility, a new way to the yet unknown solution to the problem, a relatively bumpy path compared to the easy way. Those who know its value and seek for the difficult path will eventually find their way in, and along which they shall find places they truly belong to. The New York Daily Jan 19th, 1961 Written by: John Greymirror Brown

Civil Servants Suffer Mental Breakdown Due to Extreme Intimidation The Uluru Games are on the verge of revival, igniting the flame of competition in arcanists everywhere. I'm sure many of you have heard the news already—perhaps you've even passed by the "Revival Squad" in the street, led by that precocious female student—and needless to say, everyone is very curious about them. They are, of course, a flame, a ninth-grade student, a fungus researcher, and a prominent public figure backed by the entire St. Pavlov Foundation, making for a motley crew fascinating enough to make anyone's heart burst with excitement. Just like the Bunyips, who have been seen lurking in the city's dark alleys recently, these denizens of society's dark underbelly have crawled out of the sewers and thrust themselves into the spotlight, and are fast captivating the entire nation's imagination and attention. "Following closely behind a bunny girl, a mad scientist, giant brown mushrooms, and Pixel Emu in tow, does the Melbourne shuffle by the fireside." Where could you possibly hope to see such a scene? In a science fiction movie? At the circus? In your dreams, perhaps? No—this all happened at Alice Springs City Hall. This scene of pure absurdity was also the first impression a bystander (who has asked to be referred to here as "Ms. Kate") had of the Revival Squad. We... We have undertaken all manner of large events and functions, all on behalf of guests with etiquette and a sense of propriety. But they... they're just too much! They... Oh my goodness... My upbringing doesn't permit me to repeat the things they did, please understand." The aforementioned chaos wrought by the Revival Squad completely destroyed "Ms. Kate's" day. When recounting this experience, she choked back tears multiple times and even broke out in incoherent sobs. Let us return to that glorious event and reflect on what our ancestors had to say about the "Uluru Games." Do we really need these games? Or did someone tell you that you need them to awaken the love for sportsmanship and fair competition lying dormant in your heart? What is the point of them? Selling tickets? Is this just another case of sensationalism gone mad? Go and take a look at the page you just tore out of your calendar this morning—as we stand at the end of the century, who truly wishes to exhume those long-dead and decadent traditions once again? Three color picture cards placed in a sealed, unlit box depicting apples, bananas, and pears, respectively. [Method] 1. Place the 12 Bunyips from groups A and B into their corresponding aquariums while ensuring freshwater quality and oxygen quantity are consistent. Ensure that Group A's water temperature is set to 14 degrees centigrade and that Group B's is set to 32 degrees centigrade. 2. Direct V1 to enter the room and select one of the picture cards from the sealed box at random without showing it to the two groups of Bunyips. 3. V1 then describes the selected fruit on the picture card to the two groups of Bunyips. This description can be true or false. To avoid the personal traits of individual volunteers affecting the results, the voices of the volunteers must be altered and the volume unified. 4. Record the physiological responses of the two groups of Bunyips, including dorsal fin vibration frequency, heart rate changes, and body temperature. 5. Replace the volunteer and repeat steps 2-4. 6. Determine the authenticity of the content described by volunteers via hidden camera recordings. 7. Compare the differences in physiological responses to true and false descriptions between the two groups of Bunyips. [Results] 1. When volunteers provided authentic descriptions, both groups of Bunyips remained calm. 2. When volunteers provided false descriptions, dorsal fin vibration frequency and heart rate in both groups of Bunyips increased significantly. 3. Both groups of Bunyips could sensitively distinguish between the behavior of humans when lying and when telling the truth through physiological responses, and the higher the water temperature, the more sensitive the Bunyips became. [Conclusion and Prospective Optimizations] The individual YP-07 in Aquarium B showed significant physiological deviation in its responses. Through retrospective analysis, we found that regardless of whether the description provided by the volunteers was false or not, YP-07 was more likely to believe that the picture cards drawn depicted bananas. Whether this is because the individual concerned prefers bananas or because the high water temperature affected YP-07's judgment in a way that made YP-07 more willing to believe that the fruit on the card was of a tropical nature has yet to be determined. Follow-up research will expand and optimize the current experimental setup based on these two assumptions in order to study the correlation between them.

Name: White Milk Mushroom Its introduction in the guidebook states that it is also known as the spicy milk mushroom. Is it really that spicy? I don't think I want to find out. Discovery: This mushroom was discovered at the foot of the Dandenong Ranges, in the shade beside a stream. To prevent it from drying out, I placed it in a cloche and brought it home with me. External Appearance: The cap is semispherical in shape and has a diameter of approximately 3 centimeters. Its appearance is very unique, with soft gills and a cap and stem as white as snowflakes. Unfortunately, it only grows at the foot of the ranges, not on their sometimes snowy peaks. Beneath its cap lie many small spore sacs, which, when opened, reveal spores of a creamy hue. Tissue Sample: I cut off a small piece, and when observing it under a microscope, could see that the pileus was tender and the curved hyphae were thick and wavy or annular. The structure is very similar to other milk-caps, with differences mainly reflected in color and mycelial morphology. Function: 1. Edibility Being a wild mushroom, it can be eaten raw or used as a cooking ingredient. Even after being sliced, its milk-white juice retains its inherently spicy flavor, stimulating the appetite and thus making it suitable for use as a seasoning. I'll take good care of it—whether for research or as an emergency food reserve, should the need arise. 2. Medicinal Value White milk mushroom extract boasts anti-inflammatory and antioxidant pharmacological properties. Its polysaccharides and peptide components are used in anti-inflammatory drugs, and their inhibitory effects on tumor cells are also used in adjuvant therapy for malignant tumors. White milk mushrooms can enhance the body's immune system and enhance athletic performance. *Does this mean arcanists can use it as a nutritional supplement? I'll make a note of this—I need to gather more data. 3. Environmental Indication The white milk mushroom is highly sensitive to its growing environment; thus, its growth status can provide a preliminary reflection of a forest's ecological health. This has caused it to become one of the ecological indicators for environmental assessment. Humidity, nitrogen, and pH level are all indicators that correspond to the growth status of white milk mushrooms. *This was an oversight on my part—I only recorded the growth location but forgot to test the environmental indicators. Treat this as a lesson and be more careful in the future.
