When they gave me this civil service job, I never thought I'd end up working with an emu one day.

Or perhaps I should say that when I was drowning in those irrigation project application forms I couldn't finish last month (there are always so many applications I can't seem to finish), I never thought an emu formed of pixels would be of any use to me...

But... But "Plappy" really is something else. I'm not even sure if that's its name; I just heard that girl with the ponytail call it that.

It's quiet, strong, and has a strangely trustworthy air about it, so when I noticed it flipping through unapproved forms and trying to help with them, I didn't think to stop it.

To be honest, and I'm not sure if I'm just imagining this, but I think I can sense an aura of guilt radiating from Plappy.

It's like the kind of guilt a mother clad in a polka dot skirt feels after her child's soccer ball smashes through a glass window—the sense of guilt felt by a grandmother wearing a woolen beret after her grandchildren ride their bicycles over a beautiful flowerbed. Anyway, I can always count on it to bring me a basket of golden apples, appearing at my door, then bowing down—all the way to the ground.

I know this all seems a little <nobr>over-the</nobr>-top, but whether it's true or my imagination, I have managed to calm down the "Revival Squad" formed by those rambunctious children.

Oh, that's right! I mustn't forget to return Kate's backpack. She left it at my house when she came to the housewarming party earlier. She took her sick leave immediately after and won't be at the office for two weeks straight. I saw her today—she looked good and seemed to be preparing for an interview... It's strange... Who would want to interview a civil servant? Maybe I should ask her the next time I see her.

A critter chasing after the Dust whose shape is drawn with pastel. It has no real malice, just like a child tearing the wings off a butterfly to admire its beauty.

A critter that wanders from tavern to tavern stealing liquor.
As the most accomplished of the drunkards, being blacklisted from every tavern is only the first milestone on its path to infamy.

A critter that roams the taverns, discolored by years of drinking.
It preaches the virtues of moderation and generosity to his kin, especially when it has a full belly.

An eye-catching red-maned striped horse.
When words don't matter anymore, she's glad she can still rely on her swift hooves.

The tavern's nightmare, leaving no drop of liquor wherever it goes.
Except for the most exquisite drinks, nothing can awaken it from its drunken stupor.

The bailiff of Pei City, in charge of upholding the law.
To the common people, he is a symbol of fairness and justice. He carries only a sword in his hands, using it solely for matters of law and order.

The elusive feather man.
He's an expert on bones, birds, and the tree of longevity, but that's about all he knows.

One of the team's investigators.
He once had grand ambitions, scaling peaks and traversing valleys. But now, all he desires is the warmth and comfort of his own hearth.

One of the team's investigators.
He chased after hope, but all he found was disappointment. They say he's indecisive, and that's exactly what people need him to be.

A wooden doll that frequents the tavern and persuades patrons to drink.
A loyal servant of alcohol, she is gentle and well-meaning, always understanding that your icy heart needs the warmth of the drink.

A wooden figure that frequents the tavern, persuading patrons to drink a stronger variety of alcohol.
His cups, filled with the heart and soul of alcohol, are as hard to resist as a raging bull, causing even the most seasoned drinker to run away.

A creation resembling a mythical beast.
Through countless years, in the glow of firelight and cooking smoke, they finally caught the spark and built its temple.

A creation resembling a mythical beast.
For countless years, the beasts dwelling among the peaks and rain have been blessed with grace, and have in turn nurtured its domain.

A typical horse with striped markings.
Now, without the need for argument or shyness, a rope has once again replaced its will.

A malevolent observer, an uninvited guest.
It seems more like a toy than an experiment. It offers no opportunity for friendly communication.

A strangely shaped man-made device, seemingly transmitting some signal.
It is very impolite to interfere with someone else's communication, but if you insist, it can fully file a suit with the interstellar law enforcement agency.

A crawling Critter, a giant eyeless spider.
The web it weaves is as white as snow. It's a shame that no one survives to witness the intricate craftsmanship.

A monster that roams through caves and soil horizons, emitting a foul stench.
Ranked 32nd on the "Critters You Don't Want to Encounter List," it is described as "unpredictable, and even if you escape or beat it, it's hard to wash its lingering smell off your clothes."
A little Critter that loves the cold—the most fashionable of its tribe! It meticulously maintains its metallic skin and moss flowers, and now all Critters envy its shiny casquette.

A group of Critters adapted to cold climates.
Certain Critters are quite fond of their white coloring, and to avoid shedding in the summer, they often migrate to higher altitudes.

An enthusiastic and generous little Critter.
By the road, wait—hat! By the road, chase—hat! Catch the hat! New hat! Go! Go!

A running Critter, some strange kind of entangled wolf duo.
Sometimes they bite each other. Sometimes the nights are too cold, and they huddle together.

A spark left behind by refugees at their temporary camp.
It represents that your direction is true, but before continuing your pursuit, it's best that you extinguish it first.

The spirit of a traveler who perished wandering near a snow mountain.
He waits for a passerby willing to accompany him—to find his camera roll filled with the beautiful scenery by his bones.

The spirit of a traveler who perished wandering near a snow mountain.
She doesn't like people laughing when they see her, nor does she like people screaming when they see her. She hides in the snow, instead becoming a praised and beautiful little snowflake.

A homeless arcanist, a member of the refugee group.
She no longer has any hope for her compatriots; instead, she'd rather have some friends who can't talk, or even make her friends unable to talk.

A girl with four hooves. A member of one of the deer girl tribes.
With her slender fingers, she tears tendons, with her slender fingers, she weaves garlands. Her clipping-clopping hoofbeats are ever cheerful, she is so at ease.

A giant Critter living in high-altitude areas.
Sensitive hearing and severe morning grumpiness combine to unleash this frequently insomniac abomination.

The lord of the Critters who loves the cold.
He's keen on making patterns in meadows and snowfields with his wheels—for this, he has collected dozens of kinds of "brushes."

A non-naturally formed wildfire, yet to spread.
Fed by human resentment, its energy source is mixed, not only relying on material combustion.

An exiled arcanist, a member of the refugees.
The flame keeps her from the cold, but not from hunger. With anger as a seasoning, she is willing to devour all living things before her.

Unafraid of the cold, perennially covered in snow.
She brings a warm blessing where she goes, its recipients always ecstatic, they dance fervently until their limbs stiffen.

A group of Critters who live for adventure.
With storm jackets, signposts, and weathervanes, they are ready to go and are always excited. Where did they get these things? Oh... that's not important!

A faithful follower of Manus Vindictae.
Nurtured by her loving care, within the confines of a skull, her blooms are truly mesmerizing.

A product of Manus Vindictae, devoid of any soul.
It has transcended the need for a vessel and is no longer bound by thought. This is the epitome of the mind's perfection.

An unlabeled storage bag, it's hard to say what's inside.
Little tin soldiers, old glasses, or...? Anyway, it shouldn't be moving, should it?

Perhaps this is the owner of the wooden pushcart and those tools.
She is full of sorrow and anger, but there's also an unexpected panic about her.

An arcanist wandering the land. A member of the refugees.
When she awakens, her only purpose is revenge, on everyone. This sweet taste makes her sleep better than any bedtime story.

A group of Critters with a mania for collecting gold.
Dust? Dust! Crunch, crunch, hard! Crunch, crunch, crunch, delicious!

An old control device, the key to operating old machinery.
One round and another. The next sixty rounds are no different from the previous ones. The gears creak, turning like this for so many years.

The incarnation of a nightmare sprite, with the ability to bewilder and transform.
What people fear is also what they consider to be most powerful and invincible, and so it is for the nightmare fairy—a creature that was once a warhorse. For a hundred years, this fairy has insisted on presenting itself as a knight.

An arcanist among the refugees seeking answers.
A pie is shared by everyone, so the portions are not big enough to satisfy anyone's hunger. So, if this suffering is shared by everyone, will her pain also be lessened?
A small clenched fist holds tight the things most cherished in her heart.

A faithful disciple of Manus Vindictae.
She exudes emotion, tenderness, and empathy, and guides the way for those confined by constraints.

A creation of Manus Vindictae, devoid of any soul.
It has forsaken its body and surrendered its thoughts to its sensations. This is truly the pinnacle of ecstasy.

An old mechanical device powered by its core.
It has now learned to conserve energy, drawing half its power from sunlight, nutrients and rain.

A statue born from the stubbornness of wood.
Allowing footsteps to inquire, the forest responds with silence.

This creature was formed from the discarded scales of Mothman, a harbinger of disaster.
It now resides in this desolate place, hoping to bring misfortune upon the dust and ruins. though it is a pity that no one has accepted this gift. Yet no one seems to welcome this dark gift.
A representation of a profound, lingering terror. At times, it can lift one end of a dream and then pour out malice from the other end, creating unsettling dreams.
Strong evidence of substantial harm to reality.
In one swift motion, it shatters the sense of rationality you hold so dearly.
At first glance, it may seem like a harmless decoration, just a lovely touch to enhance the dreamy atmosphere. But once you see its endless reflections, you'll realize its true nature.

Eagle was born in Washington, D.C., USA. A Knight created the Comic Knight event on his quadrennial birthday in order to bring back the long lost humor which, in most people's view, was contradictory to chivalry.|A Knight was grateful to receive the gorgeous garland on his birthday, and he wished for a more practical present for his next birthday. Every year on this day, Sotheby would receive a number of presents on this day. This was met with little interest from her friends, yet this didn't change the enthusiastic gleam in her eyes.

Today is the day X was taken in by the orphanage, which makes it his birthday. Whether it was cleaning, pouring wine, or cutting the cake, the incredible Goldberg machine could handle everything.

Last year, the American Sweetheart agency released a special birthday movie at midnight, which fans celebrate worldwide for a whole week.| There was a slang saying circulating in 1950s America that when a boy grows up to the point where he doesn't have to celebrate Children's Day anymore, June 1 takes on a new meaning - the birthday of his dream sweetheart.| Many politicians claimed to have received Sweetheart's birthday invitation and gladly went. Oddly enough, they all forgot the details of the night, and the media thought that it must be some new kind of political publicity stunt.
Everyone's favorite "American sweetheart", this shining star of the silver screen is your most <nobr>head-turning</nobr> celebrity friend.

It was the next day right after the Lord Protector's death, the day when the troupe performer named The Fool put on the funniest mask of the year.|The mysterious troupe wandering around the British Isles announced a show to be performed on that night. The Fool would fool the "king" in the performance by then.|The Fool loudly chanted a paean praising the day in a female voice. It was the day when the anticipated "entertainment" came back to life.

On this day, Baby Blue's friends in dreamland would present her with the most luxurious birthday party tea party ever.| A giant honey cake, a teapot full of fruit syrup, and a pink castle full of balloons - these are all regular features of Mr. Bunny's birthday parties.| What Baby Blue didn't know was that little Beth had prepared a little cake for her that year too - right by her bedside.

On this day, Sir Fog, of the wealthy Fog family, was born in London. Even though the <nobr>higher-ups</nobr> are well aware that it's Bkornblume's birthday, they never send her any wishes. On October 10th of some year in medieval times, Chancellor Dikke of the Special Inquisition was born somewhere in Europe.| Dikke decreed that, in accordance with the law that "justice reigns supreme", the celebration of birthdays would not be considered a violation of the law.| Dikke decreed that birthday gift must be repaid in accordance with the law of "an eye for an eye".

Curator of the Tombstone Museum. The recorder of the last wish of everyone and one of your most gentle friends.

Talking of life in the uncultivated land, Satuski can only remember the days when she stole and ran away. There seems to be nothing about birthdays.|The teahouse where Satsuki worked celebrated customers' birthdays sometimes, and the decorations at the place looked just like those in this room. She had been looking forward to seeing the star of the party until she saw her name on the cake.|Satsuki made the same simple wish on both New Year's Day and her birthday: to spend the rest of her life in that teahouse.
A tender teahouse hostess and a flower blooming again after weathering storms. One of your most endearing friends.

"Ladies and gentlemen, great offer of Neo Science Exorcism Office, 12% off only on my birthday!"|On this night, <nobr>An-an</nobr> Lee posted a post on her blog "Nai Mang Dik Si" to complain about the bad margarine which Kowloon Bakery used in her cake. The post then received a lot of likes and comments that say "Happy birthday!"||Compared to those expensive and meaningless gifts, the gadgets from flea markets are more to <nobr>An-an</nobr>'s liking.
A ghost hunter who breaks with tradition and an expert in <nobr>cutting-edge</nobr> scientific gadgets. One of your most eccentric friends.

The happiness of the family is doubled on this day, as are the blessings for Lisa and Louise.|Lisa and Louise received two hairbands of different colors on their birthday. The next day, the hairbands they wore were of the same color, but no one seemed to notice.|Lisa and Louise are always together. They hang out with the same friends, sing the birthday song in the same tune, blow out the candles at the same time, and make the same wish.

On this day in history, Ms. Matilda Bouanich, who is "destined for greatness," was born in Paris.|The one birthday invitation which Matilda was worried about among all the others was sent back again. "Sorry, the recipient is on a field mission."|There is always only one candle on Matilda's birthday cake, which means "Matilda is always No. 1!"

When the cake with lit candles was pushed to his side, Rabies wimpered like a puppy in danger and took a few steps back instinctively.|Every year on this day, Rabies would search the fields carefully for a new stethoscope. At this time, the noisy birds around him would stand on his shoulder quietly.|A straw hat was given to Rabies as a birthday gift. He purred a few times, which seemed to be an expression of thanks, even though he didn't understand what a birthday was.

Many years ago, the Tennants held a birthday banquet for their beloved daughter on this day. But now, almost no one remembers this déclassé family.|On this day, countless maidens in Paris went dizzy with love. They all just happened to encounter an elegant, charming gentleman who gave them a "unique" invitation to a birthday date.|On her birthday party, Tennant "accidentally" disclosed the source of her diamonds and received deposits from numerous rich Arabian merchants.
A diamond dealer who weaves dreams, a trickster who navigates through desires, and one of your most cunning and charming friends.

On this night, Mr. Karson served Ms. Moissan a bowl of noodles, which flattered her and deepened the stereotype that noodles are "essential at a Chinese birthday party."|The surprise box given to Ms. Moissan by some friend as a birthday gift freaked her out. She ran away, and then people heard the cracking of porcelain from the hall.|Ms. Moissan turned down the Foundation's offer of a day off for her birthday, because she had promised Sotheby to teach her how to glaze porcelains at just the right temperature.

Bette will get to play her own <nobr>stand-in</nobr> today. No script, no style limit, no cuts, just one theme: happy birthday.|Bette was flattered and almost fainted when she heard that Sweetheart the star and Charlie the troupe leader would show up at her birthday party as surprise guests.|Although the heroine fumbled her lines, it was a great show for a birthday party.

Most girls born on a summer day tend to love summer. Unfortunately, her drowning also happened on a summer day.|When people in the suitcase were discussing the theme for Poltergeist's birthday party, she drew everyone's attention by making noises and shouting "No beach party!"|Poltergeist had been nervous until her birthday finally arrived. Fortunately, she didn't grow another tentacle, probably because her age remained the same.

The training ground prepared new bite toys and frisbees for Medicine Pocket on this day. After releasing overflowing energy, Medicine Pocket believed their condition was perfect for blood sampling and suddenly stabbed themself with a syringe.|Medicine Pocket suddenly came up with a genius idea at the party and rushed back to their lab immediately, leaving confetti and cream all over the floor.|After they blew out the candles, Medicine Pocket read out their wish list loudly: new research, more funds, more...
A genius researcher who tests drugs on themselves and a reckless expert in destruction. One of your most willful friends.

Voyager considers a certain special day the birthday of the common human girl she plays. According to the calendar of Earth, the date is November 12.|The girl from far, far away showed a shy smile in the quiet room. The birthday party then started with the soothing concerto in D major.|Voyager received a pile of birthday cards from her friends, and she decided to send them a return gift: a <nobr>universe-themed</nobr> letter with mysterious symbols.
A girl as gentle as the starry skies. A serene violinist and a great listener. One of your most mysterious friends.

When asked about memories of his birthdays, Click recalled all the dangerous escapes during the war, which he didn't feel like talking about.|Click decided to open up a <nobr>birthday-themed</nobr> section in his personal photography collection, and the first photo he added was the one he took with birthday party guests.|The moment the "cake bomb" passed over Click's body and hit an unfortunate guest in the face, Click immediately raised the camera in his hand.
A daring war photographer and creator of classic collections in the suitcase. One of your most dedicated friends.

According to historical records, this was the great day when Darley Arabian was born.|A <nobr>carrot-flavored</nobr> birthday cake? Marvelous! Darley Clatter will compliment you for your taste.|Listen up, the first person to wash Darley Clatter's back with linseed oil will receive a special gift: the right to stroke the great mane of Darley Arabian!

After dancing a waltz, Eternity left her own birthday party early. She then enjoyed the night with white wine, assorted cakes, and The Night Show airing as scheduled.|When talking about the experience on birthdays, Eternity showed unusual "envy" towards ordinary people, because she could no longer feel pleasure on this day.|Eternity has no interest in the parties of young people, but she always welcomes new customers, <nobr>up-to</nobr>-date jokes, and men's affection.
The gadget shop owner who are good at doing this line of business. An interesting and kind elder. One of your most experienced friends.

News on November 16: The NewBabel Company announced that it would provide additional services such as <nobr>short-term</nobr> fostering, fur care, and customized transportation for customers who purchase critters during the <nobr>year-end</nobr> promotion.|A cake with candles, a sweet family, and a fluffy carbuncle—the themed birthday photo service provided by The NewBabel Company caused a critter photo fever in society.|Ms. NewBabel received a lot at the birthday dinner. There were birthday cards (business cooperation letters), exquisite gifts (a stack of purchase orders), and many wishes and applause.
An elegant and shrewd critter merchant and a leader of the new era. One of your most ambitious friends.

After ensuring all the toothfairy cans were tightly sealed, Tooth Fairy removed her braces and sang a delightful birthday song. |Despite the sugary buttercream cake being the <nobr>arch-nemesis</nobr> of teeth, on this <nobr>once-a</nobr>-year occasion, Tooth Fairy will still partake with joyful indulgence. |Tooth Fairy will accept any birthday gift—even a big box of candies. After all, it's not every day that someone presents a genuine tooth as a present.
A taciturn collector of teeth and a dentist with a great voice for capturing toothfairies. One of your most reliable friends.

News today: The chief journalist of Headonion unexpectedly received an <nobr>onion-shaped</nobr> cake delivered to her home, which was suspected to be a gift from the TV station. The receiver of the cake claimed that she didn't expect it at all.|As a professional journalist, ONiON didn't make her birthday the headline of the day, and she didn't regret it, of course.|There are many truths waiting to be unearthed by ONiON every day, including on this unique day of her life.

On this day in history, the satellite Sputnik 1., the first <nobr>man-made</nobr> satellite launched by mankind, was sent into orbit. The satellite involved no Arcanum.| After Sputnik had circled the giant balloon stuffed with ribbons 15 times, she finally acceded to requests to pop it.| The light from the candle in the darkness reminded Sputnik of a brilliant trailing flame. Nonetheless, she blew out the candle and made a wish that would one day come true.

On this day in the early 1970s, at Green Lake Campsite, the Zeno Academy crossbred a native North American deer girl with a Changeling to create Jessica. Researchers remember this day vividly. |Although Jessica doesn't quite grasp the significance of celebrating the day of one's birth, she is fond of today—a day featuring a giant cake, friends eager to play with her, and the blessings of Blonney. |At Jessica's birthday <nobr>dress-up</nobr> party, someone suggested playing a game of tag, in which Jessica, with her <nobr>shape-shifting</nobr> abilities, thrived like a duck takes to water. This strange anniversary has become something she looks forward to with increasing anticipation.

It's Mesmer Jr.'s birthday, but she believes the celebration of a specific date is insignificant, given her belief in rationality and practicality.|Even though Mesmer Jr. stated that she needed no gifts on her birthday, she still said thanks to the gifters in a low voice, and she would even wait for them to leave before disinfecting the gifts.|Mesmer Jr. tried to hypnotize herself on this night, hoping to get rid of the stubborn, frantic illusions in her dream for a moment. Sadly, she failed again.

On this day each year, the crew is required to offer tribute for the birth of their chief, Erick.| Strangely enough, Erick's "plundering" went exceptionally well today - everywhere the Dragon Boat sailed, shopkeepers offered candy and toys!| The great Viking warriors would celebrate their birthdays with feasts of meat and wine. Of course, Erick had to settle for Twizzlers and honey water.

On her birthday, Blonney always loves to invite her entire class to her home for an <nobr>all-night</nobr> slumber party, just like the social butterflies seen in every American high school movie. |Blonney fantasizes about staging a "Birthday Night Scare" during the party, but the poor acting skills of the "homocidal maniac" only end up leaving her friends in stitches. |Blonney once spent an utterly unremarkable birthday at Green Lake Campsite—nothing but a cake base and a birthday card. Oddly enough, she remembers that day vividly.
A blonde in the world of glitz and a rising star in the horror film industry. One of your sharpest friends.

On the eve of his birthday, Horropedia always anticipates something unusual, like a chilling knock on the door or a radio broadcast with an unchanging date. |The mail carrier must have thought it was a New Year's prank rather than a birthday present! Upon receiving the thick stack of horror movie posters, Horropedia slammed the door in feigned anger. |Chainsaws, puppets, and waterphones, instead of balloons, cakes, and birthday songs—that's the kind of birthday party Horropedia looks forward to the most.
A walking encyclopedia of horror movies and stories. A reliable master of logic. One of your most "knowledgeable" friends.

Melania prepared six different plans for today, hoping to achieve at least four A+s upon their simultaneous completion. |Guessing what surprise Ms. Acey has prepared is the annual event at Melania's birthday party. Unsurprisingly, she once again received a completely unexpected gift. |Usually, anything Melania wants, she gets without much effort. But on this day alone, she wished to receive something voluntarily offered by others.
A whimsical international thief and a meticulous top student. One of your most organized friends.

Every year on this day, Charlton prepares a "suiting" birthday gift for Pickles. By the way, this year, it's a choice between a banana boat hat and a pink bowtie. | After wagging his tail in gratitude for the birthday gift from neighbors, Pickles stared at the hourglass food ball in front of him, contemplating the essence of the "time and existence". | At the beginning of the universe, the particles that make up Pickles all had a common day of birth, so does a "birthday" still hold significance? After blowing out the candles, the little dog revealed a melancholic look.
An unusual indigo puppy and a somber philosopher. One of your most thoughtful friends.

On the second day of Valentine's Day, some astonishing street graffiti always appears on the streets of London. The London police believe this is not a coincidence and may be related to a kind of societal curiosity. | On February 15th, Diggers celebrates his significant day. The artist takes to the streets and greets all passing pedestrians, accepting blessings and the usual resistance to the new art. | This anticipated fireworks display has become a tradition for the citizens of London. Whether you are near Big Ben or on London Bridge, don't be too surprised.
A rebellious artist and a spreader of love, inspiration, and bubbles. One of your most artistic friends.

Living a routine life, Kaalaa Baunaa often forgets about her special day. After receiving unexpected birthday wishes, she starts to consider whether to include birthdays in the category of ''necessities.'' | Kaalaa Baunaa unexpectedly discovers that on this day, her luck is at its highest in a year, as indicated by the astrolabe. | Among Kaalaa Baunaa's birthday gifts are many <nobr>well-coordinated</nobr> sets and <nobr>brand-new</nobr> metal frames for glasses, but she seems utterly clueless about them.

Kanjira awoke to the hissing sounds of Punji and, following her usual ritual, performed a coffee reading. Unexpectedly, the coffee grounds formed the shape of a cake with candles. | Kanjira flipped to the forest illustration page in her book and took out a rupee bill. She planned to buy a new picture book as a birthday gift to herself. | Kanjira thoroughly enjoyed the birthday dance prepared for her. In the light of the campfire, her dance moves earned a lot of applause—it was the first time she had been the center of attention.
A master of street wisdom and a reliable companion in the caravan. One of your most resourceful friends.

On this day many years ago, Old Shaman adorned young Shamane with a mask. He danced for a day and a night. That was the first time he sensed the soul behind the mask. | During his practice of faith, Shamane was once trapped in a valley by a raging snowstorm. As the first rays of sunlight transformed the snow into a glistening wonderland, he suddenly remembered: it was his first day of adulthood. | After his practice of faith, Shamane started to organize for himself simple birthday celebrations, and he always casually asked everyone for candies as gifts.
A traveler from the melting <nobr>snow-capped</nobr> mountains and a shaman bidding farewell to the past. One of your most <nobr>open-minded</nobr> friends.

"I thought it was just a normal day, like any other day. Same morning, same noon, same night," she said with some surprise. | "Now that time is flowing out of order, in which calendar are you looking for July 27th?" That's what she said. | "It's an interesting custom to celebrate a birth with a <nobr>cream-covered</nobr> circle and a shortened line to represent age! Oh! So I should blow them out?" She looked curious.
A genius of insight and a pure seeker of knowledge. One of your most focused friends.

6 had never told anyone that today was his birthday. As a result, he strolled along the beach as usual, making his way to his office. | 6 had witnessed countless birthdays in 'Enlightenment,' filled with loud sounds and bustling crowds... As a result, he never looked forward to this day. | 6 found a creative gift in the doorway to his room—a recipe for French fries, perhaps a 'gift' from a seagull.
A perfect number maintaining balance, the leader of School of Apeiron. One of your most poised friends.

Spathodea lost a match on the eve of her birthday. While wiping her tears, she devoured the strawberry lamingtons prepared by her mother.|Yearning for the annual "Night of Indulgence," she eagerly awaited it from the moment she woke up, even skipping lunch to save room. The price was an afternoon training that left her weak and dizzy.|Under the call of Ulu, a friendly match titled "Malingee's Harvest" was staged today. Wearing a garland, Spathodea outshone everyone, a star that dazzled all.
The girl who lit the Uluru Flame and a shining new star in sports. One of your most passionate friends.

Ezra is keen on inviting numerous arcanists, carefully noting each of their birthdays—a necessary part of the birthday party, perhaps even more important than the birthday itself.|He always enjoyed the ritual: filling a glass bottle with colorful colonies, extracting spores with a water wand, and then tossing it into the air—resulting in a string of his numbers floating in the night sky.|Just for this night, he would whimsically plead with his mother after dinner to tell him about that place—a utopia free from strife and death yet of nasty cold.
A little researcher always ready to help and a rational and reliable pacifist. One of your gentlest friends.

For those who hang out in the streets, this day might not be worth commemorating. That night, Desert Flannel lingered a while in front of the jewelry shop before gritting her teeth and taking off the octopus earrings.|Exhausted after working as head chef at a <nobr>late-night</nobr> villa party, Desert Flannel collapsed onto her bed. Fortunately, the pay was good, making it a decent birthday to her in the end.|As Plappy played electronic birthday wishes, friends pushed out a red velvet cake trolley from the darkness. Desert Flannel pinched her cheek—hah, an exuberant night, that was the real pain!
A <nobr>jack-of</nobr>-all-trades in life and a <nobr>street-hustling</nobr> <nobr>8-bit</nobr> pet owner. One of your most capable friends.

In the <nobr>thousand-year</nobr> history of grand ceremonies, athletes gradually forget this ancient and solemn day—the anniversary of the first lighting of the Uluru Flame.|She closed her eyes and reminisced—sitting upright on the torch, with countless athletes cheering below. From afar, she appeared like a candle stuck in a giant tiramisu.|The origin of the date was vague to her: first, a flame pierced the darkness; then, applause and cheers echoed; some even cried in joy. It marked the beginning of the celebrations.
The venerable sacred flame, the guardian of the red land. One of your most fervent friends.

To prevent her family from incurring unexpected expenses while "preparing surprises," Yenisei always arranges everything in advance—banquets, commissions, and a new dress for her sister. |My first birthday in a foreign city. No need for pleasantries, no need for social status or etiquette, just one night to enjoy alone. This is good." This sentence was taken from a particular page of someone's travel journal. |At the confluence of many rivers, the Yenisei divines a converging direction, where roads, the future, and the today will follow.
The girl who turned her back on her family, a seemingly indifferent protector, and one of your most decisive friends.

Faced with the Timekeeper's question, Jiu Niangzi has no justification for her conviction, yet she is so certain—the beginning of the year should be the day she was born as Xiangrui. |Logically, the tavern should not allow open flames, but tonight the candles are bright and the pavilions are alive with light. Wooden dolls hide in the shadows far away, clapping to the beat that the neighbors of Pei City once drummed to celebrate a girl's birthday. |On the first day of the lunar month, guests from the wilderness gather here to honor the tavern with a cup of tusu liquor. The scene in front of Jiu Niangzi reminds her of that day in years past—after closing, Ms. Xu would always bring out the five spicy dishes she had prepared for her.
A hardworking and enthusiastic tavern keeper, a girl who strives to live up to expectations, and one of your purest friends.

That day, Getian watched as the scholar entered the city to take his exams, wiped his sweat with a cloth, leafed through books in the shadow of his hat, and then Getian completely forgot about the rest of what happened. The only thing he was sure of was that it was an extremely hot day. |Entering the door to a meeting, Getian habitually stretches out his wings—the air stirs, and a congratulatory letter written in an ancient script slowly unfolds. He is startled, but not angry. |The new scholar tree in the wilderness is the work of Druvis III. Under the tree, Getan tightens his wings and tries to tell <nobr>bone-related</nobr> anecdotes to blend in with the group. This is clearly unnecessary, as he is already the center of the birthday celebration.
The Miemeng bird that watches the world, the bone reader who has experienced countless years, and one of your most <nobr>self-contented</nobr> friends.

<nobr>Custom-made</nobr> for the Druvis family by Lugus, this 1900 commemorative edition is a part of the premium series of Samildánach Jewelry. It is also the only luxury accessory Druvis III wears. It first came out in October 1911, at a birthday party held by a mother for her daughter.

This is an incredibly peculiar wand. It appear to be an oak druid staff, with a white <nobr>scythe-shaped</nobr> decoration which signifies the holy moon on top and the white buds of mistletoe surrounding it. Its core is made of cat whiskers, expired painkillers and a handful of black ashes. She has named it "Otherworld."

The layering of the flower arrangement, the silk decoration, and the green and white flowers go so well with her clothing that the final result is almost a work of art. "It wasn't <nobr>custom-made</nobr>. I just picked them up at random" She said. I should probably find myself a new bouquet designer.

The 1920s witnessed a boom in cubism. The preference of geometric features not only influenced the design of the Chrysler Building but also changed the design of women's clothes. As new ideas collided with the old, a revolutionary change took place—the modernization of society. In the US, modern science was realizing dreams. Steam trains, Ford cars and the radio gave the world every reason to feel optimistic about the future. Jazz music was played throughout the night, and the people dancing the Charleston never felt tired. Nobody could stay out of the craze, especially those aristocrats who had fallen from a position of power but still tried to find a respectable place in America. "Stop telling me about your illusions." The mother gently threw a genogram with an oak sigil on it into the fireplace. "The moment you got on that ship, you became an American." 
"Embrace the 'New Age' with us."

She remembers every tree growing in the Cascade Range.
The shape of the moss on the trunk, the uneven pattern of the tree rings, the size of the ant colony by its root... They make every tree different in its own way. To listen to their whispers, she failed her mother again and again, running away from the endless banquets into the long night of the forest.
Her stepfather was also familiar with every tree in the Cascade Range.
As a tycoon in the logging industry, he was keen to give a lengthy speech about the value of woods.
The faster his stock price rose, the more talkative he became.
Things changed, however, in 1928.
The supply chain of woods suddenly collapsed, and he became more and more silent. The Great Depression left out no one—it is like another <nobr>upper-class</nobr> banquet, but this time no one wished to be invited. At that point, bulldozing the forest and selling the land seemed to be the only choice. When her parents signed the contract, she was nestling against the branches of an oak, trying to keep a feather floating in the air with her incantation.
In this autumn in Cascade, she wished to live differently.

Pandora Wilson: I heard that your mother betrayed her arcanist family for the American Dream. I'm curious, what is your understanding of the American Dream?
Druvis III: I don't understand it.
Pandora Wilson: ...

Pandora Wilson: What if you were to describe it in one word? I think the American Dream is a belief, if you ask me.
Druvis III: It's also business.
Pandora Wilson: It's like a firework show.
Druvis III: It's like a mess of ashes.
Pandora Wilson: You seem to have a quite negative approach to it. 
Druvis III: I'm sure everyone sees it differently.
Druvis III: Perhaps, we can only truly understand what the American Dream is after hearing enough criticism about it.

A special helmet designed for the Soviet air force. It is made of Wurt hide, a species able to endure the bitter cold, and a secret refined metal. Owing to the special materials and craftsmanship involved, it is incredibly expensive. The bear ear design on top inevitably increases air drag, but it doesn't seem to bother her at all.

A quadrate canteen made of stainless steel. It comes with a strap which makes it easier to carry around. It was still filled with spirits when we received it. Is it just her, or every Russian does this?

The key to <nobr>Su-01</nobr>ве.
An important tool used to activate the brooms. There isn't much to say about its ordinary design.

After WWII, the eagle and the bear bared their fangs at the throne.
The Iron Curtain speech signaled the beginning of the lengthy Cold War. The government picked out the children with arcanum talent from all over the world and sent them to Zeno Armaments Engineering and Technology Academy where they would be trained to become a hidden yet powerful force. 
Under the strict adminstration of Zeno, they have grown into obedient, persistent, efficient and silent soldiers.

But they were still young children after all, and children always make trouble.
They came from different countries and had different faiths, ideas and habits, which led to conflicts. The most noticeable troublemaker among them was, without a doubt, the pilot girl from Russia.

A Letter from the Mesmer Family

To Alefkhem Royal Hospital, Director Jeffrey August Kurton (Recipient) * * * Dear Mr. Kurton, I recently heard that you have become the hospital director. Congratulations! You are living proof that our family has had a significant impact on this world. You truly are one of the top students among the hundreds supported by the Mesmer family. Apropos of your achievement, we are writing this letter in the hope that you will admit a special patient for us—an arcanist of the Mesmer family. You may have read the gossip about him in the newspapers... but we can assure you that he is simply a doctor who has brought shame to his family for deviating from tradition. Recently, newspapers have even spread rumors that swarms of journalists have descended upon us after hearing the news, and have surrounded our doors, causing us great distress. After our subsequent diagnostic evaluation, he was diagnosed with monomania and thus requires strict behavioral control therapy. We have high hopes for you and will deliver him to you promptly. We hope that you can provide him with standardized treatment and restraint, as well as limit his contact with the outside world. As for the term of his treatment, the Mesmer family has discussed this matter and hopes that he can receive treatment at Alefkhem for life. Furthermore, all factors considered, we are very much looking forward to your future research results; therefore, we have decided to provide long-term funding to the Royal Hospital. Your Benefactors, The Mesmer Family

Recorder: Dr. Buru Kreplin June 27th, 1900 Patient No.17 was admitted to our hospital without any background information, medical history, or formal diagnosis certification. The director personally took him in and declared him a monomaniac patient with no further ado. He displayed normal behavior, no stereotypical traits, and is only allowed to consume liquid food due to being in restraints. Abnormalities: Extremely concerned about other patients and has a habit of keeping handwritten records over long periods of time. July 20th, 1900 Patient No.17 induced other patients to gather in the lobby, using unknown means to evoke physical symptoms in said patients, such as epilepsy, crying, laughter, and vomiting. Dozens of hospital instruments were damaged, and four nurses and one physician suffered minor injuries of varying degrees. The investigation indicates that Patient No.17 stole instruments from the hospital's abandoned instrument warehouse and used these instruments and the power of suggestion to hypnotize the other patients, leading to a hospital riot. The warehouse has already replaced the rusted chains with the instruments returned. After being administered a high dose of anesthesia, Patient No.17 has been detained in Underground Guardhouse No.2. Abnormalities: The warehouse has remained unused for years. The patient seemed very familiar with the structural layout of the hospital. July 25th, 1900 At 13:00, the patient did not respond to the inquiry. The nurse observed through the viewing hole that there were blood stains on the ground. The patient was slumped against the wall and exhibited no vital signs. After being rushed to the emergency room, the patient suddenly awakened and struggled to break free several times; thus, we had no choice but to administer an additional dose of anesthesia. A thorough physical examination revealed that the wound on the patient's wrist was only a minor cut, and the patient was actually in a conscious state throughout. Abnormalities: The patient began writing on the walls in a script most difficult to recognize. The director refused to share any additional information about him, and now the hospital is in disarray. Nobody wants to have anything to do with this complete horror show! The nurses are losing their minds—everyone knows he's none other than the infamous arcanist doctor!

July 22, 1900 I thought I was going to die in this putrid pigsty. Eminent jackasses of our most distinguished line, thank you... though I don't think they realize just how wonderful a place they put me in. An endless supply of patients, infinite experimental data... It makes my hands tremble with excitement just thinking of it! Franz Anton Mesmer mentioned this place in his notes! I found the glass harmonica he lost in the sealed warehouse, signed with his name—it was all absolutely true! This device is crucial for inducing neurological responses—as for the risk... the pursuit of knowledge has always required certain small sacrifices. Old Mesmer's conservatism almost ruined the future of magnetic flux therapy. I anticipate that if the brain is guided by human instruments and combined with the magnetic flow therapy of the Mesmer family, the soul can transcend the body, making the deepest secrets of the brain known at last! I have decided to name this theoretical technology "artificial somnambulism" after drawing up a rudimentary prototype. Those sticks-in-the-mud with one foot in the grave will have their milky, mushy brains blown out by my research. As a side note, the nurses and doctors have been bickering non-stop outside recently. Something about a journalist being personally received into the director's office...

Journalist: Director Kurton, a large number of patients' families have launched a joint protest in front of the London governmental offices, stating that admitting arcanists as patients may pose a threat to the lives of the other patients. Jeffrey August Kurton: I understand... their concerns. No one wants to be in a room with a dangerous arcanist, let alone a dangerously insane arcanist. Jeffrey August Kurton: But please just imagine, just imagine, Mr. Journalist, if he were not admitted into our care, this dangerous lunatic may have one day shown up at a school, in your carriage... or even before your daughter's window. Jeffrey August Kurton: His sins are not grave enough to warrant imprisonment, and the latent danger he poses is quite obvious. So... where else would you have me throw him? In the Thames? Britain needs a place where such people can find shelter. Of course, I must make sacrifices to achieve this vision, but history is built on the sacrifices of great men. Journalist: As far as I'm aware, the Alefkhem Royal Hospital will be the first in the world to receive an arcanist patient. Do you really think you have the ability to control this... aberration of the Mesmer family? Jeffrey August Kurton: Of course. I have developed a strict regime of treatment and control for the patient. Figuratively speaking, he is no more than a caged bird with its wings cut off. Journalist: But according to the information I have received, the Mesmer family offered you... Jeffrey August Kurton: Now, now, come a little closer, sonny Jim... Journalist: ...

Mesmer Foundation Officially Founded This month, the Mesmer family officially announced the establishment of the Mesmer Foundation at Great Britain's Royal College of Psychiatrists, providing long-term funding for outstanding medical students. This is their eighth foundation established in Europe. In the 70s, Franz Anton Mesmer of Vienna proposed the theory of "animal magnetism" and designed magnetic flow therapy techniques to be applied to the human body. Through its unique hypnotic methods and ability to control magnetic flow, the technique has been effective in curing mental disorders such as hysteria and fainting in patients and has since gained much repute among the medical community. Magnetic flow therapy later became a unique brand of treatment practiced only by the Mesmer family, with most family members being hired as exclusive physicians for oligarchs and political party leaders upon reaching adulthood. Although many still question the effectiveness of magnetic flow therapy, this has not prevented the Mesmers from becoming the most well-known medical family in London. Still, rumors abound concerning the family, with some saying the two most mysterious places in all of London are the boudoirs of Buckingham Palace and the consultation room of the Mesmer estate. Reporter: James Stanson

An Investigation into Magnetic Flow Therapy After conducting a survey of anonymous patients as compiled in this report, it has been found that magnetic flow therapy is far from achieving the high cure rates claimed by the Mesmer family when facing the public. A large number of arcanist patients hold doubts about the therapeutic effects of such therapy, stating that it only has a brief hypnotic effect. The treatment methods of the Mesmer family are still limited to the theories of Franz Anton Mesmer, the founder of magnetic flow therapy, and have not made any significant breakthroughs in the past hundred years. As things stand, the Arcanum community is recommended to conduct a fresh evaluation of the benefits of the Mesmer family's magnetic flow therapy. —Journal of European Arcanum, 1893 The Mesmer family faces several charges: The French Academy of Sciences, which previously followed and investigated Franz Anton Mesmer's work, has recently joined forces with the British Academy to investigate patients treated by the Mesmer family. The joint investigation committee formed by the two nations stated that this move aims to expose the falsehoods of the Mesmer family's magnetic flow therapy and unveil the secrets hidden beneath the Mesmer family's century-old veil of secrecy... It is particularly ironic that, as a member of the Mesmer family mainly versed in psychotherapy, Scott Mesmer, a physician once appointed by the British royal family, was recently admitted to the Alefkhem Royal Hospital due to mental health issues. The Mesmer family has not yet commented on this incident. —The Times, 1900

September 18, 1900 This hellhole is a bottomless abyss of darkness. My quilt's all moldy and smells like death—I tried unfolding it, and a swarm of insects came flooding out... The rats that come in through the window at night are so big, they could gnaw a hole in my head. I don't know when this rash broke out on my neck. Whenever I scratch it, the layers of skin just peel off without end, accompanied by grotesque, oozing pus... They're getting wise... They won't fall for my old tricks anymore. In the morning and in the evening, a trembling woman comes to deliver food. She doesn't answer me, as though afraid I might clutch onto her voice and drag her inside. At noon, an old man throws a plate in like he's putting out food for a pig, then leans against the door while smoking, coughing like his throat is riddled with gaping wounds. He calls me "the pig in the basement" and likes to kick the door with his heel. Sometimes, we exchange a few words... He rants on about the prostitute who gave him sores and curses the tight-fisted director for his paltry wage. He knows me. He knows I'm a Mesmer. I reached out my hand and told him that treating his sores would really be very easy. As for a reward... all he had to do was reach in and light a cigarette for me. I knew he had seen my arms, which were thin and ghastly, like twigs that might snap in a strong breeze. He agreed without much hesitation. It's all thanks to him and the fact that he is not much cleverer than the average sewer rat. ...

Recorder: Nurse Mary Hartley January 21, 1911 I can't believe it! The Alefkhem Royal Hospital is truly more easy-going than any other hospital I've been to. The nurses and doctors even outnumber patients... All we need to do is check their physical and mental well-being at the same time every day—they're all so old that they can barely hold a glass of water, much less go on a mad rampage. January 22, 1911 I received a request from the director to go down to the basement and deliver lunch to a special patient. He warned me, "Close your mouth, lower your eyes, put the plate in, and leave." I did as he said. The basement door was sealed with a great many locks, which made me feel rather uneasy... I threw the plate in and ran out in a panic. But... I still heard someone sobbing and smelled a stench that made me want to vomit. January 24, 1911 He... begged me. His voice was terribly old. It reminded me of my grandfather in Knaresborough... When death came to him, he gripped my hand tightly and spoke in the same voice... January 25, 1911 His voice was resounding and powerful, that much I cannot deny. I can't imagine how an old voice like that might have such a passionate soul behind it. It was just like... a young man was trapped in that old body. He rambled on incessantly, claiming to be able to treat the patients... Crazy talk, really. Even so, his symptoms are far from severe enough to warrant such harsh treatment. January 26, 1911 He asked that I send a letter to his family, and I took it from him. Written on it in crooked writing was the name "Scott Mesmer." I must speak with the director...

Nurse Hartley: Mr. Director, sir, from my observations, the patient in the basement is merely a poor soul who lacks self-control... Director Kurton: Clearly, you failed to follow my advice. Nurse Hartley: His level of self-control is no different from that of any ordinary person's, and he doesn't show any aggressive tendencies—only occasional symptoms of delusion... Director Kurton: Are you familiar with Dirty Hook? Nurse Hartley: I don't see what that has to do with this patient. You must... Director Kurton: He was previously responsible for supervising Scott Mesmer. Mesmer managed to hypnotize him in some mind-boggling way... Even now, he's still completely hysterical... mad as a hatter. You must know that he's one of the few patients in the hospital who must be shackled at all times. Nurse Hartley: I'm not sure... Director Kurton: And till now, I've been paying for Hook's hospital expenses out of my own pocket... Do you understand now? Nurse Hartley: I understand, Mr. Director... Nurse Hartley: But... Mr. Mesmer has a letter he'd like to send to his family, and I don't see how this could possibly affect our work... Director Kurton: Of course. I respect the rights of every patient here. Leave it on my desk. ...

To the Mesmer Family Mesmers: I must declare in advance that this letter was not written to beg for mercy from you few decaying moths to release me from this hospital. Before I was admitted to this place, the reputation of the Mesmer family had long since fallen. You lack foresight with your antiquated views and carry the legacy left by our great ancestors like a group of penniless misers on the brink of death. The extraordinary insights of the young disappear in a puff of smoke, and the sensibilities and inspiration deep in the arcanist's soul are bound by what you call rationality. You distort your own souls and push arcanists to embrace the polar extreme. The Mesmer family is in urgent need of transformation. I hereby truthfully inform you of the findings of my research at the Alefkhem Royal Hospital. Old Mesmer once noted in his diary his experiences in using a glass harmonica and magnetic flow therapy to treat a patient, but later abandoned this experiment due to the worsening of his patient's condition. Coincidentally, I discovered my great-grandfather's discarded glass harmonica in the hospital and conducted synchronous experiments using magnetic flux therapy and glass piano hypnosis on a fellow patient. ... Compared to magnetic flow therapy alone, with the assistance of an artificial instrument, namely the glass harmonica, the patient was more likely to enter a deep hypnotic state. The patient's performance shows that the sound frequency is a vital consideration in guiding the patient, and theoretically, there is a possibility one might apply directional induction of complex brain functions such as imagination, memory, and emotion. I have named this tentative theory and its related phenomenon: Artificial Somnambulism. This study will bring unprecedented changes to the field of Arcanum and even to the entire world. I need a member of the family to bring me back to the outside world. I feel like I don't have much time left, and for me, confirming this hypothesis is more important than my freedom. Yes, I am willing to swallow my pride for the sake of this request. I sincerely implore you, every last Mesmer, to understand the value behind this theory. I need your help more than ever. Scott Mesmer

September 19, 1900 That drunkard finally fished up something. He spoke at length with my guest and even struck a deal. Trembling, he reported to me how conscientious Mesmer is, like a beggar asking for a few more pence. Hawke, my dear Hawke, the adorable idiot covered in mud and manure—I generously dropped a few pence into his pocket. When I saw him nodding, bowing, with his eyes lighting up, I said: "That lunatic can treat your sores. He may be insane, but his conscience is still alive in there." He was so overjoyed that he almost bent down to kiss my shoes. The next time Mesmer uses him to sneak out, he'll find himself in a new and even better cage. Hawke simply needs to pretend to be as crazy and foolish as he seems, and I'll be saved a lot of risk and expenses. No one will question the control I exert over Scott Mesmer. The support I receive from the Mesmer family is sufficient to sustain the operation of the entire hospital and support my comfortable lifestyle.

January 21, 1931 We gathered up the food trays to find that, for several consecutive days, the ones in the underground guardhouse were covered in rat droppings, and the food was basically untouched. I knocked on the door and called out to him, holding my breath, but heard only silence. The director stated that this was just a new trick he was using to escape from his room—that there was no way Mesmer could hold out, and we wouldn't have to wait long before receiving a shiny tray, licked bone clean... January 25, 1931 A nauseating odor wafted up from the basement. It was one I was familiar with... One time, my father forgot to throw away some old beef, and within a few days, flies and maggots had infested that rotten meat. I couldn't cook anything in the kitchen for a month after that. I have a bad feeling... The director finally ran down there and tried to open the door, but the tangled iron chains on the top had rusted, and the keys wouldn't turn in the lock hole. We used bolt cutters to cut open the iron chain and pry open the rusty lock. It took us quite a while to get that heavy door open. As we neared the guardhouse, the stench rushed up my nostrils like some sticky liquid... I knelt down on the ground, vomiting and trembling. A dense nest of rats squirmed all over Mr. Mesmer's rotting body, wriggling like a swarm of insects—the entire room, the tiles, the walls... any space available was covered in crooked, eerie handwriting. I dread to imagine how he survived such a long time in those conditions. I looked through the moldy bed and found a piece of paper—it was a suicide note. I don't understand why I did it, but I... hid it in my pocket. It was all I could do to salvage his last shred of dignity.

His shattered body was consumed by flames. In that blazing inferno, not a single bone remained.

    Scott Mesmer's name was erased by the family, and Jeffrey August Kurton was ordered to destroy all hospital records related to him. He died silently and without a name.

    A murder of crows flocked upward and departed in haste as the nurse carrying an attaché case lingered in front of the solemn gates. She reached out a hand and then retracted it.

    She bent down and stuffed an arcanist's last dignity into the crack between the doors...

April 15, 1931 Hook, having pretended to have lost his mind, has somehow managed to endure for over 20 years without being sent to his grave! He shamelessly grabbed at my box and begged me for money to take care of his son, whom he apparently hadn't seen in decades. This brazen swine is just looking for an excuse to strap a few more wine bottles on his waist. I gave him a firm punch, but he held on to my leg and refused to let go. At that moment, an incessant banging began assaulting my office door, as if all hell's atrocities had been squeezed into this one day! I opened the door to find a group of people from the Mesmer family, solemn-faced and carrying briefcases. I swear, if this interferes with my prospects in any way, I'll throw that Hook into a real madhouse! As I led them into the guardhouse in Zone 4, Room 1, my legs began to shake... But the Mesmer family seemed indifferent to my apprehension. They opened their cases, took out their strange instruments, and then pulled out their notebooks, copying the twisted handwriting on the walls and floor tiles like silent sculptures without saying a single word. On the <nobr>light-gray</nobr> floor and the walls scatter the logos in <nobr>champagne-like</nobr> color. The <nobr>well-arranged</nobr> stone pillars manifest the greatness of this building while the cold, hard cement bricks and granite bring about order and obedience to this place.
It must be a magnificent scene when it collapses.
I'm not sure. I can't even tell if it is really built with cement bricks and granite.
It's just somehow, I have a strange feeling since I arrived.
That familiarity feels so natural and justifiable, like the smell of wheat when you cut the white bread, or the yellowed postcard found in the middle of a book.
At this moment, a flash of inspiration strikes me, like a lightning flickering in the depths of my brain.
I don't remember anything.#Hold on to that momentary feeling
But the familiarity is not just an illusion. I know that.
A spark lights up the match. "Fwoosh," a small, flickering flame appears in silence.
I am running out of time. I must leave and do what I should do.
What are you doing here? The training has started. C'mon, do what you're supposed to do.
As their standard wands fall to the dust, the delightful ringing from outside the fence declares my victory.
Congratulations. Your excellent performance has brought you an undoubted victory.
You are the best graduate of the year, and I'll be more than willing to prepare an honorary certificate and a reference which is commensurate with your performance.
But before that, you must complete a small final test for your graduation.
Some rioters of the Manus has captured this building. Go show them what you've got.
So that's ... what I'm supposed to do?
What are you looking at? Don't play dumb, it's you!
Busted, huh?! You've been peeking at her! I saw you!
She talks so fast, reminding people of the tranquil lake which reflects the snow on the Alps.
But of course, she has nothing like the lake itself. She is like the speedboat making huge noises on the lake which ruin the tranquility and shredder the serenity of the snow mountain into pieces.
Her tone suddenly goes down as if this speedboat had run out of power.
She keeps hinting a direction with frequent glances, as if there lies a strong magnet which causes the failure of the speedboat's engine or attracts her eyes forcibly.
Who is she?#Actually I was staring at you.
What? <nobr>Y-Y</nobr>-You ... You don't know who she is?
<nobr>Y-You</nobr> saw me ...? No, I didn't peek at her all the time! Hey, you hear me?
You'd better keep this in mind, she's MY rival! Only I get to beat her!
Correction: only a rival like her deserves to be beaten by the incredible me! Remember, the No.1 student can be no one but me!
<nobr>N-No</nobr> way, the incredible me lost to you ... This can't be true!
She runs away while talking to herself.
So what on earth was she doing?
In the shadow of the ship hide several rioters of Manus Vindictae.
Speaking of which, what does Manus Vindictae mean? Is it some kind of arcane skill?
Their bodies look just the same as anyone else's, but the creepy way they move around somehow seems to be slimy and logy.
Black slime dropping from the gaps of their armors and robes, they look disgustingly creepy.
I have to admit I am curious about the nature of the slime, but I will never, ever touch it.
Curiosity doesn't always result in action. That's the difference between human and moth.
Those satisfying their curiosity without consideration will eventually pay for their thoughtlessness.
And that was quite high a price.
The rioters of the Manus have spotted me and their scream pierces my ears. It seems I can't describe them as friendly.
My eardrums slightly ache, as if there's a ball bouncing on them.
At last, everything is settled and nothing is left.
I am clear what I should do. I have made up my mind, and all I need is a little push.
I will beat them to prove myself.
A strange question suddenly comes to my mind: what am I fighting for?
This question must mean something, but I don't have to figure it out right now. All I need to do is to beat them, as ordered by the instructor.
Mission completed. Time to go back and report.
I will be the best graduate of SPDM of the year.

Cony's gorgeous palace appears within reach. The ripples follow one after another, shattering to form a pool of lamentation.
Shadow Play at a Candlelit Night
The light of the candles falls upon the drapery. Only the majesty of the striped horse of legends that gallops against the wind, flying over mountain rivers in the distance can equal this.
Offer it questions and sincerity, and it will hand you the key.
A bonfire rises, a stone pillar is erected. Hearing the sound, the crowd descends in droves.
Colliding and intertwining, the footsteps of wisdom echo in this place, across the ages.
Every life comes to an end, and every building returns to rubble. Only wisdom lives on, forever seeking its next form.
Every life comes to an end, and every building returns to rubble. Towering above, atop the Eternal Heights, form is no longer a necessity.
Like a galloping foal, it has broken free from the shackles of the desert.
As the heat subsides, they sit in a circle, awakening the silent voices of their hearts.
Look here, look here... the eternal history seared with flames!
A grand return, a rekindled blaze of passionate hearts.
The serene days of yore are reborn here.
On a summer day without a trace of dark clouds, it too was never absent.
It just wants to take a good nap among the snowdrifts and the gifts, and send you greetings for the snowy season.
It suddenly appears on a day as the year draws to a close, preserving the memories of days gone by.
A painting needs its frame, and here you can have countless landscapes.
Many pairs of hands laid the first bricks, and so, it embraces the plain with open arms, towering like a mountain.
The intoxicating aroma of liquor lulls you into a drunken reverie. Take your time, indulge in a drink.
The tasks of the New Year are already complete. Amid the swaying bamboo shadows, spirits and humans alike fill their cups.
After a busy day filled with scrolls, golden leaves in the courtyard catch the eye.
Birds take flight and return, clouds gather and disperse, garments experience fray and flourishing, yet it remains here.
Fearless flowers bloom in the marketplace, adorning the bustle of the Dushuo Festival.
Spinning, singing, it lends fresh vigor to the pulse of the land.
Carvings of auspicious beasts now rest in the wilderness, perhaps dreaming of spring rivers on the grasslands.
Flowing downstream, accompanied by good winds, it already knows that the river is warming.
Petals fall leisurely into dreams, grains in the pot are not yet ready.

Endless millet fields, oddly shaped utensils. The distant and flourishing land of the East, where <nobr>self-sufficient</nobr> people no longer rely on sacrifices for a bountiful harvest. But the joy of reunion once a year still needs a vessel, and it is happy to take on this duty.
A dependable friend who silently and steadfastly carries our burdens, time and time again.
Let us sing the spirited song that can make delicate flowers bloom in the midst of heavy snow.
Used to unlock a certain archipelago in the Wilderness.
The Wilderness is waiting for the new residents it deserves. Speaking of residents, this kindhearted landlord is almost never picky about anyone.
A venue of birthday celebrations ... or for any other things that worth celebrating.

Everybody has to walk on that path, the path that leads to paradise and graveyard. But we will remember this day, and never feel lonely.
The jokes from a knight, the special, touching moments for the orphans, a break from a long journey ... and there's more.
Winds of spring blow across the new soil and sweep across the pond.
Winds of spring blow across the new soil and sweep across the pond. Its destination is the green riverbank, where the blossoming roses await.
Buildings rise, and buildings fall. The wheels of time continue to carry the town going forward.
In the waves of noise, people find their inner peace here.
The river tells the history of a country.
The river tells the history of a country. The booming sound of the steam age is carried downstream, along with the industrial waste that comes with it.
Buildings rise, and buildings fall. The wheels of time continue to carry the city going forward. The memories of the city will be long hidden within.
In the waves of noise, people find their inner peace here. This is the "philosophy of life."
The fungus creeps up and infects the new soil.
The fungus creeps up and infects the new soil, sparing no living thing.
Hush! Don't look at the lake, don't wade in either...
Hush! Don't look at the lake, don't wade in either... Lastly, watch your back.
Blood stains, split branches, a torn shirt... Who knows what happened to the chainsaw?
Blood stains, split branches, a torn shirt... Who knows what happened to the chainsaw? What's that smell? Could it be that... the fuel tank cap isn't on?
Fresh meat and traps—shortcuts are the best way to lure prey...
Fresh meat and traps—shortcuts are the best way to lure prey... Unfortunately, wild animals know this just as well.
In the distant snowy plains, the snow melts into water and joins the river to flow over the pebbled riverbed since the dawn of time.
Mists shroud the place, yet there are endless insights for the faithful here.
Mists shroud the place, yet there are endless insights for the faithful. Where the sacred figures are gathered, Rama's deeds will long be held dear.
Oh, the river! All detailed histories tell of this place.
All detailed histories of the river tell of this place. Following this, the darkness consumes the light of the beautiful lamps.
All detailed histories of the river tell of this place. Following this, the river and the beautiful lamps all flow towards their collective doom.
At the root of all things, dryness parches every grain of sand and rock. This place was once blessed by prayer and Fate.
Dwelling in a distant sea, as beautiful as a mother of pearl. Shh... It's enjoying this moment of silence and serenity.
Here you may rest, here you may converse... To seek the home of reason, one must be as pure as the truth.
The soul's shell has fallen here forevermore.
The rolling waves crashed down upon it like doves.
The sky's mirror is also the ship's veil.
<nobr>Drip-drop</nobr>—the pulse of greenery vibrates ceaselessly within the earth.
Stinky boots, canned food, beer, and hope... it pulls the carriage, back and forth between towns and deserts.
Upon the soil bathed in scorching sunlight, people have finally lit the first torch.
Upon the soil bathed in scorching sunlight, people have finally lit the first torch, with footsteps stirring like flocks of sparrows taking flight.
Hush, before the sun licks the dew away...
Hush, before the sun licks the dew away, before the sands lose their way and return...
The earth split in two, the sea banished to a corner of the world.
The earth split in two, the sea banished to a corner of the world, tiny beings follow the trail.
Stepping firmly on the loess, travelers pause and returning guests are engrossed in their hometown.
A place to dwell; as the daylight fades, people return to their homes.
A place to dwell; the moment to return home has arrived, the scent of burning pine and cooking smoke is carried on the breeze.
People are content here; the sounds of chickens and dogs are heard everywhere.
People are content here; a year of toil in exchange for the joy of festivals, the smell of spring dishes and tusu liquor fills the neighborhood.
It quietly awakens in the spring and follows the boat energetically for thousands of miles.
With bags and wine flasks in hand, in the stretch of clouds, it seeks that silent old friend.
The first clap of spring thunder will sound; then, joy and anticipation will grow with the new sprouts.
In memory of our first encounter on the other side of the door. The soil, the river, and the living beings, they have waited in the silent land for long ...
There once was a city which nurtured prosperity, freedom, and all kinds of possibilities. Now, it will start again in the Wilderness.
Silence is the invitation from the forest. The car goes in and never comes out again. The campfire is about to die out. It is time for the appointment ...

This is the city where the wheels of Fate turn. People light their candles to banish evil spirits before purifying themselves in the sacred river. Henceforth, all fortunes shall improve to receive a new lease on life.
On a sea of dust, before it all began.
The flames rise in cheers and applause. They stand tall, look up, and leap high.
Spring and fall are changing, the first day is approaching. Here the river is full and the grass is green. Here one can remain aloof from the world and be serene.

That most beautiful, kindhearted girl in our thirteenth story.

A pearl as pure and white as a tooth.

... I will get you, anything you want.

Think of it that way, it's not that bad to be a freak … Who knows, maybe.
I'm glad you say so—Watch out, they're coming.

Be patient, blondie. You can always run over them with your vehicle.
We're getting closer to the truth. Stay alert, everyone. I don't want to bring my medical kits out at this moment.

Please help me prepare an Ultimate. It might be of some use.

Aha! Don't worry, just speed up with Kanjira … !

… Can I just run over them?

Sotheby and Druvis are unable to travel with us. I'm sure they'll be curious to hear all about our experiences!
As a considerate and approachable friend to all, it's absolutely crucial that this Captain fulfill their expectations!
Oh, so you're writing a sincere account for your investor, eh?
So she can use the Miracle Solution for you again next time?
